name: p11_evt_get_cutscene_pack_data_ptr
summary: Resolves payload pointer inside cutscene pack_hdr using entry count *(s16 *)(pack_hdr+2) and slot offset.

name: p11_evt_upload_cutscene_pack_cluts
summary: Scans pack slot flags for 0x8000 CLUT entries and uploads palettes to VRAM at (g_npc_evt_unpack_cutscene_script_upload_counter_pack_cluts, g_npc_evt_unpack_cutscene_script_upload_counter_1).

name: p11_evt_get_cutscene_pack_payload_size
summary: Computes byte size of the final cutscene pack payload block between end slot offset and next entry offset.

name: p11_evt_find_cutscene_pack_end_slot
summary: Scans cutscene pack slot flags (+4) for 0x4000 end marker; raises SystemError('N') if none before slot 0x1a.

name: p11_evt_populate_cutscene_offset_table
summary: Extracts cutscene pack slot offsets matching flag mask 0x3c00 into g_npc_evt_populate_cutscene_offset_bind_value; raises SystemError('A', 999) on overflow.

name: p11_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_actors
summary: Binds unpacked cutscene sprite animations from g_npc_evt_unpack_cutscene_script_bind_value+g_npc_evt_populate_cutscene_offset_bind_value onto player, NPCs, or prop sprite slots.

name: p11_evt_copy_actor_sprites_to_cutscene_slots
summary: Copies active NPC sprite blocks from g_npc_evt_copy_actor_sprites_value into cutscene backup g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_copy_table and loads weather sprites.

name: p11_evt_alloc_cutscene_sprite_slot
summary: Finds a free slot in the 10-entry g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_value sprite array, initializes anim, and assigns prop_id in g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32.

name: p11_evt_reset_cutscene_sprites_and_props
summary: Clears 10 cutscene sprite slots ending at g_npc_evt_cutscene_sprites_props_value, clears g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32 props, and sets g_npc_dlg_active_cutscene_portrait_evt_counter to 1.

name: p11_evt_begin_cutscene_player_state
summary: Enters cutscene state: sets flag 3, locks player controls, updates festival flags, and clears active player anim.

name: p11_evt_end_cutscene_and_unlock_player
summary: Terminates active cutscene: clears flag 3, refocuses camera on player (-2), unlocks player controls, clears held item g_core_player_state_held_item_id, and resets prop 0x36.

name: p11_npc_clear_cutscene_actor_flags
summary: Clears cutscene control bits 0x1800 in field 0x0f across all 37 NPC records at g_npc_actor_tbl_base.

name: p11_evt_reset_cutscene_icon_slots
summary: Initializes 5 pairs of cutscene portrait/icon tracking slots at g_npc_evt_cutscene_icon_slots_value to 0xffff.

name: p11_evt_init_cutscene_map_object
summary: Initializes cutscene map object sprite slot via p11_animl_save_snapshot_vram using g_anim_upload_afile_snapshot_slot_evt_state and (object_id - 0x15f).

name: p11_evt_decompress_rle_buffer
summary: Decompresses RLE-encoded cutscene buffer into dst using sentinel byte *src and repeat length src[3].

name: p11_dlg_submit_portrait_sprt_tpage
summary: Allocates and links SPRT and DR_TPAGE GPU primitives into ot_entry for portrait rect cached at g_npc_dlg_submit_portrait_sprt_upload_state_sprite_vram..ac.

name: p11_npc_set_actor_move_command
summary: Dispatches NPC movement/path commands via g_npc_actor_move_command_jtbl_ptr or item category check via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags.

name: p11_npc_emote_and_move_actor
summary: Triggers NPC emote balloon emote_id via hm_ovl11_spawn_npc_emote_balloon and issues move command with speed 0xc.

name: p11_dlg_show_script_message
summary: Opens script dialogue box with weather-2 typhoon text ID remap table g_npc_dlg_show_script_message_value and saves player choice to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_npc_warp_actor_pose
summary: Unfreezes NPC npc_id (if < 0x32) or animal slot g_npc_warp_actor_pose_table and writes XYZ world coordinates directly.

name: hm_ovl11_spawn_npc_emote_balloon
summary: Displays speech/emotion icon sprite above NPC head using 0x0E balloon animations

name: p11_npc_set_actor_frozen_flag
summary: Sets or clears NPC freeze/pause bit 0x800 on actor record (or invokes p11_field_clear_world_entity_slots(0) when npc_id is 0x2c).

name: p11_npc_transition_actor_map
summary: Transitions NPC actor map ID in g_npc_transition_actor_map_position_ovl_table (or all 1..36 when 0x2a), warping or hiding as needed.

name: p11_evt_select_location_cutscene_map
summary: Resolves conditional cutscene target map ID from g_npc_event_progress_flags progress bits, event flags, season, and festival state.

name: p11_evt_pan_camera_to_target
summary: Smoothly interpolates camera target g_core_spawn_pos_x..a8 toward target XYZ or dispatches preset camera modes via g_npc_evt_pan_camera_target_jtbl_ptr.

name: p11_evt_set_player_cutscene_lock
summary: Locks or unlocks player cutscene bits across g_player_status_flags, g_core_engine_flags0, and g_player_action_flags using g_player_interact_target.

name: p11_npc_handle_gift_give_opcode
summary: Reads player held item g_core_player_state_held_item_id into VM var out_var, turns NPC toward player (0x800e65ac), triggers item reaction 0x800e698c, and unlocks player (0x800e63c8).

name: p11_npc_face_actor_toward_player
summary: Computes cardinal direction from player g_player_pos_x toward NPC/animal slot and updates facing or emote balloon.

name: p11_evt_test_property_vs_const
summary: Reads actor/flag property via p11_npc_read_actor_or_flag_property and compares against rhs_const via cmp_op.

name: p11_evt_test_property_vs_vm_var
summary: Reads actor/flag property and compares against script VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[var_idx].

name: p11_evt_compare_vm_var_to_const
summary: Compares script VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[var_idx] against constant rhs_const via p11_evt_compare_vm_values.

name: p11_evt_compare_two_vm_vars
summary: Compares two script VM variables in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars using p11_evt_compare_vm_values.

name: p11_evt_is_property_in_range
summary: Reads actor/flag property prop_id for target_id and returns true if value lies within [min_val, max_val].

name: p11_evt_run_script_command_const
summary: Executes event script command cmd_id with constant arg_val via hm_ovl11_run_event_script_step.

name: p11_evt_run_script_command_var
summary: Executes event script command cmd_id passing g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[var_idx] as third parameter to hm_ovl11_run_event_script_step.

name: p11_evt_update_vm_var_arithmetic
summary: Performs arithmetic operation arith_op on script VM slot g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[dst_var_idx] with immediate or VM variable operand.

name: p11_evt_apply_property_to_vm_var
summary: Reads actor/flag property prop_id and applies arith_op into script VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[dst_var_idx].

name: p11_evt_control_xa_audio_stream
summary: Starts CD XA audio stream track_id via hm_audio_start_cd_xa_stream or polls playback completion when g_core_submode_state == 0.

name: p11_evt_request_map_transition
summary: Requests warp to map_id in g_ovl11_fade_swap_bgm_livestock_evt_counter, runs screen fade if requested, and plays or stops BGM upon arrival.

name: p11_evt_play_scene_bgm
summary: Initializes SPU SEQ audio and starts scene BGM for g_core_event_script_ctx_transition_mode using volume (capped at 0x3f/0x7f by map).

name: p11_evt_fade_and_stop_bgm
summary: Starts BGM fade-out over frames ticks (default 10) or waits/stops SEQ audio when fade finishes.

name: p11_evt_control_screen_fade
summary: Starts screen fade in/out or queries fade completion via hm_poll_pad_input and unlocks player on fade mode 2.

name: p11_evt_set_script_active_and_festival
summary: Toggles script event flag 3 via hm_event_flag_set and forwards fest_mode to p11_evt_set_festival_control_flags.

name: p11_npc_adjust_affection_wrapper
summary: Thin wrapper calling hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection(0, npc_id, delta_val, 0) to apply a scripted NPC affection change.

name: hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection
summary: Evaluates villager affection/event precondition against NPC state in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars

name: p11_evt_load_tool_or_item_anim_pack
summary: Loads tool/item animation pack via 0x800d6a94, 0x800d7338, and 0x800cb540 using either equipped tool g_player_equipped_tool or rucksack slot g_player_rucksack_tools.

name: p11_evt_play_held_item_anim_and_stamina
summary: Plays held item g_core_player_state_action_sub_vars_idx10 animation via 0x800d7338 and optionally applies stamina/fatigue cost via 0x800c4f44 on g_core_player_state.

name: p11_evt_run_pet_or_horse_naming_prompt
summary: Opens or reads back player/farm/dog/horse naming screen buffer g_npc_evt_pet_horse_naming_animal_value into g_anim_dog_state_idx8/g_ui_evt_pet_horse_naming_snapshot_value.

name: p11_npc_spawn_or_warp_actor
summary: Warps or configures an NPC actor's coordinates and state in g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_spawn_table..88; recurses across IDs 1..36 when 0x2a.

name: p11_evt_advance_time_or_check_morning
summary: Checks if morning 6:00 elapsed (when target_hour==-1) or tests/advances clock g_farm_cal_hour against target time.

name: p11_evt_start_festival_ceremony
summary: Configures festival scene state g_core_map_transition_state=0xc, flag 0x47, clock, NPC visibility, and festival control flags.

name: p11_evt_roll_random_and_compare
summary: Draws PRNG integer in [0, max_val) via hm_prng_next, optionally saves to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[out_var_idx], and compares to rhs_const.

name: p11_evt_control_or_query_target_substate
summary: Resolves target_id (optionally from VM var when from_var != 0) and executes mode 0..4 substate control (0x80107c80) or status query (0x8010734c).

name: p11_evt_check_target_substate_active
summary: Invokes 0x800e7a74(target_id, 4, 0, 0) to test whether target_id is in an active/non-idle scripted substate.

name: p11_evt_draw_fullscreen_fade_quad
summary: Submits a 320x240 fullscreen colored overlay quad to g_gfx_active_disp_ctx_ptr OT via gfx_alloc_poly_f4_rect.

name: p11_npc_trigger_or_wait_actor_anim
summary: Starts animation anim_id on NPC slot (or player at 0x29 via g_farm_player_controller_movement_evt_count) and returns 1 when finished.

name: p11_npc_add_or_query_affection
summary: Adjusts or queries villager affection via hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level and stores result in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_run_field_crop_or_npc_check
summary: Queries or mutates farm field/greenhouse grid tiles (g_farm_field_grid/g_farm_greenhouse_grid) and writes result to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_save_or_restore_player_rucksack
summary: Saves (restore_flag==0) or restores (restore_flag!=0) held item and rucksack tools (g_player_held_item/c0/f0) in backup buffer g_npc_evt_save_restore_player_value_1..40 for cutscenes or mini-games.

name: p11_dlg_show_script_text_entry
summary: Fetches dynamic script text entry via hm_text_fetch_script_entry into g_npc_dlg_show_script_text_value and opens text prompt.

name: p11_evt_spawn_or_clear_festival_chickens
summary: Spawns 4 festival chicken actors (hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup(0x109), flag 0x40000) using g_npc_evt_spawn_clear_festival_value positions, or releases entries in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl via 0x800e2904.

name: p11_evt_spawn_or_reset_cutscene_dog
summary: Spawns the player's dog actor (ID 0x15e) for an event cutscene or resets dog state g_anim_dog_state via 0x8010b64c.

name: p11_evt_trigger_festival_ceremony_script
summary: Enqueues secondary festival event script via 0x800f1038 and starts the festival ceremony sequence via 0x800e7798.

name: p11_evt_focus_camera_on_actor
summary: Pans or locks camera onto player (0x29/-2) or NPC actor position g_npc_evt_sync_camera_follow_face_table via p11_evt_pan_camera_to_target.

name: p11_evt_place_script_prop_slot
summary: Places scripted prop slot slot_idx in g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32 table with XYZ position and sets active bit 1.

name: p11_evt_place_prop_near_npc
summary: Places g_npc_evt_cutscene_prop_slots_alloc_lut32 script prop slot_idx adjacent to NPC npc_id offset by cardinal direction dir.

name: p11_evt_check_player_held_item_category
summary: Evaluates player held item g_player_held_item against target_cat preference tier 1..7 and writes tier to g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_dlg_wait_choice_or_close
summary: Checks if dialogue prompt result matches expected_choice, or closes dialogue window when expected_choice is -1.

name: p11_npc_set_actor_pos_from_vm_vars
summary: Unfreezes NPC npc_id and assigns XYZ coordinates from three script VM variables in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_warp_and_face_player
summary: Warps player position g_player_pos_x..08 from immediate args (mode==0), VM vars (mode==1), or resets/faces via 0x800cd0c0 + 0x800e9284, updating fatigue via 0x800cb4e0.

name: p11_evt_step_player_auto_walk
summary: Drives demo pad masks g_player_pad_held/g_player_pad_edge to walk player position g_player_pos_x/g_player_pos_z to target_coord.

name: p11_evt_play_player_cutscene_anim
summary: Plays or cancels custom cutscene sprite animation on player struct g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_play_value with facing g_player_facing_dir.

name: p11_npc_set_player_or_actor_facing
summary: Sets cardinal facing direction facing_dir on the player (g_player_facing_dir + hm_ovl11_update_player_controller) when entity_id < 0x32, or on actor g_npc_face_actor_toward_player_facing_table.

name: p11_evt_apply_cutscene_stamina_delta
summary: Applies constant delta_val or VM variable stamina/fatigue adjustment to player state g_core_player_state via hm_ovl11_apply_tool_charge_effect.

name: p11_evt_get_or_set_event_flag
summary: Gets or sets persistent event flag flag_id via hm_event_flag_get/hm_event_flag_set depending on is_get.

name: p11_evt_is_edible_or_gift_item
summary: Checks whether item_id (or VM var) is special ID 0xa4 or a valid edible/gift item in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr descriptor table.

name: p11_npc_spawn_actor_from_vm_vars
summary: Resolves up to 4 script VM variables from g_ovl11_script_vm_vars and delegates to p11_npc_spawn_or_warp_actor.

name: p11_evt_play_script_sfx
summary: Plays sound effect sfx_id via hm_audio_play_sfx and returns 1.

name: p11_npc_set_actor_visibility_flag
summary: Updates visibility/collision bits on g_npc_evt_bind_cutscene_pack_spawn_table NPC records, recursing over IDs 1..36 when npc_id is 0x2a.

name: p11_evt_pan_camera_from_vm_vars
summary: Reads target XYZ coordinates from script VM variables g_ovl11_script_vm_vars and calls p11_evt_pan_camera_to_target.

name: p11_evt_consume_offered_item_check
summary: Consumes and logs offered item g_core_player_state_tool_charge against target_cat or checks g_core_scene_flags delivery flag bit 0x20.

name: p11_evt_check_or_set_clock_time
summary: Tests whether clock g_farm_cal_hour:g_farm_cal_minute reached (hour, minute), or sets clock via p11_core_trigger_instant_transition.

name: p11_evt_step_bgm_volume_fade
summary: Starts a BGM volume fade in/out over frames ticks or polls active fade completion.

name: p11_npc_reset_actor_position_and_anim
summary: Zeroes velocity, target offsets, and clears active cutscene flags on g_npc_actor_position_dbg_table_page_villager..4e for NPC npc_id.

name: p11_evt_bind_cutscene_node_index
summary: Resolves active cutscene graph node inside g_npc_livestock_status_panel_evt_bind_value (0x10 stride) and stores its 1-based index into g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_evt_set_cutscene_node_branch_var
summary: Writes low byte of script VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[var_idx] into active cutscene node branch byte (+1).

name: p11_evt_dispatch_script_opcode
summary: Dispatches event script opcodes 1..0x1f through jump table g_npc_evt_dispatch_script_opcode_jtbl_ptr.

name: p11_npc_emote_and_step_command
summary: Shows NPC emote balloon emote_id and issues movement command with speed/stride 0x14.

name: p11_npc_spawn_emote_or_face_player
summary: Looks up NPC position via hm_ovl11_get_npc_record_ptr(0x23, npc_id) and either spawns a directional emote (mode==2) or turns NPC to face player via 0x800e65ac.

name: p11_evt_set_festival_control_flags
summary: Configures event flags 4, 5, and 0xb0 via hm_event_flag_set for festival/cutscene control mode.

name: p11_evt_choreograph_goddess_festival
summary: Choreographs Harvest Goddess and seasonal festival multi-NPC formations using g_npc_evt_choreograph_goddess_festival_value_1/48/70 tables and helpers 0x800e5adc, 0x800e5b84, 0x800edf3c, 0x800f07ec.

name: p11_npc_step_actor_circular_dance
summary: Advances circular festival dance position for NPC npc_id around VM-stored XZ center using soft-float sin/cos.

name: p11_evt_test_vm_indexed_property
summary: Reads property prop_id for entity ID stored in g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[target_var_idx] and compares against rhs_const.

name: p11_evt_run_script_step_var_target
summary: Runs hm_ovl11_run_event_script_step for cmd_id using target ID from g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[target_var_idx].

name: p11_evt_choreograph_bachelorettes_festival
summary: Positions and animates 5 bachelorettes or Harvest Sprites during festival scenes from g_npc_evt_choreograph_bachelorettes_festival_value/90/a4 tables according to VM variable mode_var.

name: p11_npc_apply_festival_script_to_all
summary: Broadcasts festival script step across all villagers 1..36 (excluding 0x1b, 0x21), branching by gender via p11_core_dispatch_scene_fx_callback.

name: hm_ovl11_dispatch_npc_gift_reaction
summary: Evaluates villager gift preference tier, adjusts affection points, and selects dialogue reply

name: p11_evt_step_npc_choreography_to_var
summary: Invokes 0x800f07ec with npc_id and VM target coordinates (x_var, z_var), writing the completion result into VM variable out_var.

name: p11_npc_get_actor_schedule_location
summary: Reads NPC or animal map/zone IDs from g_npc_tracked_at_tile_calendar_actor_table_event_flags/g_npc_actor_schedule_location_table into script VM variables g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: hm_ovl11_update_npc_schedules
summary: Massive NPC schedule and waypoint router placing villagers by hour, weekday, season, and weather

name: p11_npc_apply_festival_script_to_present
summary: Broadcasts festival script step across active/frozen NPCs with bit 0x800 set in actor table, branching by gender.

name: p11_npc_query_actor_to_vm_var
summary: Queries or picks an actor via p11_ui_run_animal_picker_dialog(target_id, 1, ...), stores the result into VM variable g_ovl11_script_vm_vars[out_var], and returns true if != -1.

name: p11_evt_drive_player_collapse_or_sleep
summary: Drives or polls player dizzy/collapse/special-sleep state bits in g_player_status_flags (& 0x800000/8) and g_core_player_state_target_scene_anim via 0x800cd670 and 0x800e9284.

name: p11_npc_pick_random_top_bachelorette
summary: Picks among eligible highest-affection bachelorettes (IDs 3, 7, 9, 0xe, 0x14) with PRNG tie-break into g_ovl11_script_vm_vars.

name: p11_npc_give_harvest_sprite_treat
summary: Handles Harvest Sprite treat/gift reaction, updates g_npc_give_harvest_sprite_treat_row_count/g_npc_give_harvest_sprite_treat_dbg_value chore bits, and awards affection.

name: p11_npc_turn_entity_toward_target_and_emote
summary: Computes facing angle from entity_id toward target_id via 0x800f06d8, applies facing via 0x800e9284 or emote via hm_ovl11_spawn_npc_emote_balloon, and unfreezes via 0x800e5c60.

name: p11_npc_is_npc_unlocked_for_event
summary: Checks town presence prerequisite flags (0x129 for NPC 0xb, 0x25 and season!=1 for NPC 0x14) before spawning.

name: p11_evt_step_fireworks_overlay_fx
summary: Renders randomized fireworks flash bursts via gfx_alloc_poly_f4_with_tpage and plays fireworks SFX 0x46/0x47 driven by VM timer.

name: p11_evt_draw_backdrop_and_npc_portrait_anim
summary: Draws dark full-screen backdrop (hm_draw_poly_f4_panel) and plays NPC sprite animation at (80, 60) via hm_ovl11_get_npc_record_ptr(0x24) and hm_sprite_play_at_pos.

name: p11_evt_setup_festival_arena_spawn
summary: Computes festival arena spawn coords g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars..88/g_core_spawn_pos_y from g_npc_evt_save_restore_player_setup_value..54 tables and script VM vars.

name: p11_evt_eval_new_year_or_farm_fortune
summary: Evaluates marriage, shipping, field planted %, and NPC affection into g_npc_evt_eval_new_year_tv_counter outcome code (0xc..0xe).

name: p11_dlg_get_new_year_fortune_text_ids
summary: Evaluates New Year fortune outcome via p11_evt_eval_new_year_or_farm_fortune and writes dialogue text IDs 0x7b7..0x7bb.

name: p11_dlg_get_farm_eval_dialogue_ids
summary: Maps farm evaluation score from g_npc_dlg_eval_dialogue_ids_count_1/fa/fc tables into three script dialogue ID VM variables.

name: p11_evt_get_camera_follow_npc
summary: Returns signed 16-bit camera target NPC index stored in g_npc_evt_pan_camera_target_focus_counter.

name: p11_evt_clear_cutscene_scratch
summary: Zero-clears 0x50 bytes in the cutscene scratch buffer via memset and returns 1.

name: p11_npc_probe_script_property
summary: Probes actor/flag property reader p11_npc_read_actor_or_flag_property for dialogue condition evaluation.

name: hm_ovl11_tick_npc_ai_and_talk
summary: Updates NPC pathing, facing toward player, and dialogue script trigger

name: p11_evt_sync_daily_milestone_events
summary: Clears daily flags 0x26..0x2a, triggers pending cutscene slots 0..4 via hm_ovl11_trigger_cutscene_script, and updates spring day 7 state.

name: p11_evt_schedule_future_event_date
summary: Advances 7+ days ahead from current date g_farm_cal_year..f4 avoiding festival collisions and writes (year, season, day).

name: hm_ovl11_trigger_cutscene_script
summary: Looks up heart/festival/town cutscene preconditions and activates event script event_id

name: p11_evt_record_scheduled_milestone_date
summary: Dispatches milestone handler via g_npc_evt_record_scheduled_milestone_jtbl_ptr or stamps current calendar date into g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_counter/g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_table.

name: p11_evt_schedule_wedding_or_birth
summary: Schedules future wedding/childbirth/festival milestone in g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_table and updates spouse/marriage flags.

name: p11_evt_clear_scheduled_event_slot
summary: Resets 12-byte scheduled milestone record at g_npc_birthday_anniversary_flags_trigger_evt_table[slot_idx] to unscheduled defaults.

name: p11_evt_check_scheduled_date_available
summary: Checks if target (season, day) avoids festivals, birthdays, and spouse schedule conflicts at g_npc_trigger_cutscene_script_evt_scheduled_counter/g_npc_evt_scheduled_date_available_ovl_count.

name: p11_npc_is_cliff_present_in_town
summary: Checks flags 0x25 and 0xc9 (plus 0x20 when include_winter_job != 0) to determine if Cliff remains in town.

name: hm_ovl11_run_event_script_step
summary: Executes scripted cutscene bytecode step controlling camera, NPC walks, flags, and dialogue

name: p11_npc_read_actor_or_flag_property
summary: Reads an event flag (prop_id in 0x31..0x31f) or typed NPC/player struct field via hm_ovl11_get_npc_record_ptr.

name: p11_npc_clamp_property_value
summary: Clamps NPC/game property value against min/max bounds in descriptor table g_npc_clamp_property_value_table_1/g_npc_clamp_property_value_table_2.

name: p11_evt_compare_vm_values
summary: Evaluates script comparison mode cmp_op (0:>=, 1:>, 2:<=, 3:<, 4:==) between lhs and rhs.

name: p11_evt_apply_vm_arithmetic
summary: Applies arithmetic operation arith_op (0:=, 1:+=, 2:-=, 3:*=, 4:/=, 5:%=) to script VM variable pointer.

name: hm_ovl11_get_npc_record_ptr
summary: Returns pointer into villager state table for npc_id

name: p11_npc_get_max_villager_affection
summary: Scans all 36 villagers 1..0x24 skipping festival entries to return maximum affection value.

name: p11_npc_get_married_spouse_index
summary: Checks marriage flag 0x1b (unmarried) and spouse flags 0x1c..0x20, returning spouse index 0..4 or -1.

name: p11_evt_sum_shipped_items
summary: Sums all 25 shipped produce counts in g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value plus shipped fish count g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_record_cfg16.

name: p11_evt_calc_farm_planted_percent
summary: Counts planted/worked tiles across farm field g_farm_field_grid_idx2 and optional greenhouse g_farm_greenhouse_grid_idx2, returning percentage.

name: p11_evt_is_worked_field_tile
summary: Returns 0 for empty/weed/stone/stump field tile IDs (0x3a..0x40, 0x167..0x175) and 1 for tilled/planted tiles.

name: p11_npc_find_top_bachelorette_candidate
summary: Finds highest-affection bachelorette index 0..4 in g_npc_find_top_bachelorette_candidate_value/g_npc_actor0_affection, returning -1 if below 500.

name: p11_evt_sync_barn_and_coop_animals
summary: Synchronizes barn and coop animal states by invoking p11_field_deliver_newborn_animals(1) followed by p11_field_deliver_newborn_animals(0).

name: p11_evt_check_animal_birth_ready
summary: Checks barn pregnancy flag (0x200 in g_anim_barn_slot0_flags) or coop egg hatch state (0x10a in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl) against upgrades.

name: p11_evt_run_animal_birth_naming
summary: Commits newborn calf/lamb/chick name from g_npc_evt_pet_horse_naming_animal_value into barn g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl_idx0_scene_id or coop g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl_idx0_age_days record.

name: p11_evt_deliver_newborn_barn_animals
summary: Scans 4 newborn animal delivery slots via 0x800f0380, clears barn pregnancy bits in g_anim_barn_slot0_flags, registers newborn via p11_field_clear_breeding_pair_entry, and refreshes via p11_field_sync_outdoor_animals_from_tables.

name: p11_npc_calc_cardinal_facing_dir
summary: Computes 4-way cardinal direction index (0..3) from src_pos XZ toward dst_pos XZ.

name: p11_npc_calc_gift_affection_delta
summary: Looks up base gift affection delta in g_npc_gift_affection_delta_value, applies wrapping/birthday bonus, and multiplies by 5 on festivals.

name: p11_npc_step_scripted_choreography
summary: Drives multi-phase NPC scripted choreography (hops/circle/emotes) in g_npc_evt_sync_camera_follow_face_table using state_ptr.

name: p11_dlg_upload_portrait_sprite_vram
summary: Resolves portrait_id in g_gfx_clear_render_entity_slot_spr_table_alloc_model and uploads its texture and CLUT to VRAM via LoadImage/DrawSync into g_npc_dlg_submit_portrait_sprt_upload_state_sprite_vram.

name: p11_npc_apply_npc_schedule_overrides
summary: Copies seasonal/spouse NPC schedule overrides from g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_value_1, g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_value_2, g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_count, and g_npc_apply_schedule_overrides_value_3.

name: p11_evt_copy_script_bytecode_buffer
summary: Copies 0xe10 bytes of active event script bytecode into g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_cfg and resets g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_state_pending_event.

name: p11_evt_dispatch_pending_event_script
summary: Dispatches queued event script buffer g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_cfg via hm_ovl11_run_dialogue_choice_prompt when g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_state_1 != 0 and g_core_engine_flags1 bit 0x800 is clear.

name: hm_ovl11_check_event_trigger_zone
summary: Evaluates area trigger zone_id and launches matching event flag or cutscene

name: p11_evt_enqueue_secondary_script_wrap
summary: Thin wrapper forwarding secondary event script_id to 0x800f1354 for deferred cutscene/dialogue execution.

name: p11_evt_enqueue_primary_script_wrap
summary: Thin wrapper forwarding primary event script_id to 0x800f12d0 for immediate or queued event dispatch.

name: hm_ovl11_run_dialogue_choice_prompt
summary: Runs interactive yes/no or multi-choice dialogue prompt and writes selected option

name: p11_evt_enqueue_primary_event_script
summary: Allocates primary script queue entry via p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_mode1 when scene allows (or script_id >= 300) and stores script_id.

name: p11_evt_enqueue_secondary_event_script
summary: Allocates secondary script queue entry via p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_mode2 when scene allows (or script_id >= 300) and stores script_id.

name: p11_evt_has_active_dog_or_barn_slot
summary: Scans livestock/pet state entries starting at g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx4 for an active slot matching slot_id.

name: p11_evt_match_season_day_window
summary: Tests whether calendar clock_ptr falls within [start_day, start_day + span_days] or matches 0x1f wildcard.

name: p11_evt_match_day_of_season_range
summary: Tests if day-of-season *(s16 *)(clock_ptr+4) falls within wrapped 30-day window [start_day, start_day + span_days].

name: p11_evt_match_packed_map_condition
summary: Checks packed 6-bit map ID ((cond_bits & 0xffff) >> 10, 0x3f wildcard) against active map *(s16 *)(g_core_event_script_ctx_pad_0x04+2).

name: p11_npc_check_stage_in_range
summary: Queries current NPC stage via 0x800eebf4 and checks whether it lies within [min_stage, max_stage] honoring 0xff wildcards and flags bit 0x400 fallback.

name: p11_npc_match_bachelorette_marriage_cond
summary: Evaluates bachelorette marriage bitmask conditions against g_npc_trigger_cutscene_script_evt_scheduled_counter spouse ID and heart/rival status.

name: p11_npc_check_actor_affection_threshold
summary: Checks if NPC affection (or horse affection g_anim_horse_state_idx22 at 0x33) meets or falls below threshold.

name: p11_evt_check_three_dialogue_flags
summary: Unpacks three 10-bit event flags (+0xfb offset) via p11_evt_unpack_three_flag_ids and checks all match expected_state.

name: p11_evt_check_paired_recipe_flags
summary: Verifies low 10-bit flag (+200) is set and high 10-bit flag (+200) is cleared for packed recipe/event condition.

name: p11_evt_check_player_held_item
summary: Returns true when player held item ID g_core_player_state_held_item_id equals cond_bits & 0xff.

name: p11_evt_check_held_or_offered_item
summary: Dispatches dialogue trigger_type against g_npc_evt_copy_script_bytecode_dispatch_state_1, verifying held item (case 3) or offered item (case 4).

name: p11_evt_run_story_cutscene_if_valid
summary: Returns 1 immediately if table_idx == -1, otherwise executes the corresponding story cutscene entry via hm_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table.

name: p11_evt_check_rival_heart_event_prereq
summary: Returns true when event flag (cond_bits & 0x3ff)+0xfb is unset and p11_evt_has_active_dog_or_barn_slot returns 0.

name: p11_evt_eval_schedule_condition_mask
summary: Evaluates packed event condition bitmask across season (0x800f1bd0), weekday (0x800f1c48), weather (0x800f1cc4), and actor presence (0x800e6ee0).

name: p11_evt_check_season_bitmask
summary: Tests current season g_farm_calendar_clock (0..3) against season bits 0x40000000..0x08000000 in cond_mask.

name: p11_evt_check_weekday_bitmask
summary: Tests current weekday g_farm_cal_weekday (0..6) against packed weekday bits 0x04000000..0x00100000 in cond_mask.

name: p11_evt_check_weather_bitmask
summary: Tests current weather g_farm_current_weather (0..4) against weather bits in cond_mask with 0xc3800 wildcard.

name: p11_evt_eval_packed_field_bits
summary: Unpacks 5-bit condition bitfields (>>0x19, >>0x14, etc.) to evaluate packed event prerequisite ranges.

name: p11_evt_unpack_three_flag_ids
summary: Unpacks up to three 10-bit event flag IDs (0x3ff mask) from packed_flags into out_ids[0..2].

name: p11_npc_map_bachelorette_index_to_id
summary: Maps bachelorette slot index 0..4 to NPC actor ID (3, 7, 9, 0xe, or 0x14).

name: p11_npc_init_all_daily_schedules
summary: Initializes all 37 NPC records in g_npc_actor_tbl_base from schedule bytecode g_npc_all_daily_schedules_value for day_seed.

name: p11_npc_eval_conditional_schedule_opcode
summary: Evaluates conditional NPC schedule bytecode opcodes (0xfffc/0xfffe/0xfffb + event flags) to pick schedule offset.

name: p11_npc_update_all_schedules_for_time
summary: Updates schedule slot index field [0x11] across all 37 NPCs in g_npc_actor_tbl_base for minute_of_day (skips 0x168).

name: hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level
summary: Computes villager heart color tier (0..10) from raw affection counter

name: p11_dlg_tick_mailbox_reader_ui
summary: Drives open mailbox letter UI state g_npc_dlg_tick_mailbox_reader_evt_state_open_read/94: advances to next letter via 0x800f2724, triggers year gift 0x800f3840, or closes on button 0x20.

name: p11_evt_open_mailbox_and_read_first
summary: Reads next letter from mailbox via p11_evt_read_next_inbox_letter or shows empty-mailbox dialogue 0x221.

name: p11_evt_init_mailbox_queues
summary: Clears all 20 inbox and pending-mail slots via g_ovl15_field_all_animal_pickup_evt_state+0x49e6/0x4a36 and resets g_npc_evt_mailbox_queues_generate_state.

name: p11_evt_queue_mail_notification
summary: Routes mail immediately to p11_evt_enqueue_inbox_letter or queues into 20-slot pending buffer g_npc_evt_queue_mail_notification_advance_count.

name: p11_evt_advance_daily_mailbox
summary: Expires same-day old inbox mail, promotes pending mail from g_npc_evt_queue_mail_notification_advance_count, and generates today's new letters.

name: p11_evt_read_next_inbox_letter
summary: Opens head letter from 20-slot mailbox g_npc_evt_advance_daily_mailbox_read_counter in dialogue window and shifts remaining queue via memmove.

name: p11_evt_enqueue_inbox_letter
summary: Appends letter (sender_id, letter_id, g_farm_cal_day) to the 20-slot mailbox g_npc_evt_advance_daily_mailbox_read_counter, shifting out oldest if full.

name: p11_evt_remove_mailbox_entry
summary: Deletes slot_idx from inbox g_npc_evt_advance_daily_mailbox_read_counter or pending mail g_npc_evt_queue_mail_notification_advance_count via memmove and clears tail slot.

name: p11_evt_generate_daily_mailbox_letters
summary: Checks seasonal dates, upgrades, spouse, dog, and milestone flags to enqueue new letters via p11_evt_queue_mail_notification.

name: p11_npc_probe_unmarried_flag
summary: Probes bachelor/unmarried event flag 0x1b via hm_event_flag_get.

name: p11_evt_grant_year_milestone_gift
summary: Awards year-milestone item/Power Berry 0x103 via hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection and 0x800e6f34, and advances stored milestone year g_npc_evt_grant_year_milestone_execute_flag.

name: p11_evt_add_fodder_count
summary: Adds 1, 6 (mode 2), or amount (mode 3) to fodder stock g_ui_evt_add_fodder_count_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_fodder_count
summary: Subtracts amount from fodder stock g_ui_evt_add_fodder_count_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_add_chicken_feed_count
summary: Adds 1 or amount (mode 2) to chicken feed stock g_ui_evt_add_chicken_feed_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_chicken_feed_count
summary: Subtracts amount from chicken feed stock g_ui_evt_add_chicken_feed_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_add_fish_food_count
summary: Adds 1 or amount (mode 1) to fish food stock g_ui_evt_add_fish_food_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_fish_food_count
summary: Subtracts amount from fish food stock g_ui_evt_add_fish_food_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_add_festival_medal_count
summary: Adds 1, 10 (mode 1), or amount (mode 2) to festival medal count g_ui_evt_add_festival_medal_consume_counter, clamping maximum at 999.

name: p11_evt_consume_festival_medal_count
summary: Subtracts amount from festival medal count g_ui_evt_add_festival_medal_consume_counter if sufficient, returning 1 on success or 0.

name: p11_evt_record_shipped_item
summary: Logs shipped fish/crop into g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_record_cfg16, g_npc_show_dog_affection_msg_evt_state revenue, and g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value bin counters; unlocks flag 0x5f at 200 fish.

name: p11_evt_map_item_to_shipping_bin_idx
summary: Maps shippable item_id (0x41..0x4f, 0x5d..0x5f, 0x88..0xe5) to shipping histogram index 0..0x17 or -1.

name: p11_evt_reset_daily_shipping_totals
summary: Zeroes 22 bytes at g_npc_evt_daily_shipping_totals_field_cfg8 and 10 bytes at g_npc_evt_daily_shipping_totals_flag for daily shipping/tracking counters.

name: p11_evt_finalize_daily_shipping_gold
summary: Commits daily shipping gold g_npc_show_dog_affection_msg_evt_state on non-festival days once per day (guard flag 0xa0) and resets accumulator.

name: p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count
summary: Returns shipped count from g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value for item_id via p11_evt_map_item_to_shipping_bin_idx, or -1 if invalid.

name: p11_evt_stage_item_into_basket
summary: Adds item_id to portable basket buffer (capacity 30 in g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_counter), accumulating g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_state gold and g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_count bin.

name: p11_evt_commit_staged_shipped_items
summary: Flushes staged basket shipping counts g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_count and revenue g_npc_evt_stage_item_into_commit_state into g_npc_evt_sum_shipped_items_generate_value (cap 999) and g_npc_show_dog_affection_msg_evt_state.

name: p11_evt_try_claim_once_flag_bit
summary: Checks bit 0x400 with bit 0x4000000 unset in g_npc_event_progress_flags, setting 0x4000000 and returning 1 once.

name: p11_evt_tick_scene_props_and_icons
summary: Runs per-frame scene prop logic (0x800f5404), map prop bubble icons (0x800f5944), and carried prop updates (0x800f4a58) when g_core_engine_flags1 bit 0x4000 is clear.

name: p11_evt_sync_farm_props_on_season_change
summary: Updates seasonal house/farm prop variants for season_idx and resets spring seasonal prop anchors when season == 0.

name: p11_evt_refresh_all_scene_prop_groups
summary: Iterates all 19 prop groups in g_farm_field_plot_slot/g_npc_evt_refresh_all_scene_apply_counter to sync active bits and disables farm props.

name: p11_evt_refresh_house_props_for_season
summary: Refreshes seasonal house upgrade prop visibility for current season g_farm_calendar_clock.

name: p11_evt_try_pickup_scene_prop
summary: Attempts to collect an active/seasonal scene prop at slot_ptr (remapping 0x139/fall mushroom) into out_item.

name: p11_evt_get_interactable_prop_item
summary: Returns prop item ID when active for current season g_farm_calendar_clock, remapping autumn ID 0x40 to 0x13a.

name: p11_evt_reset_scene_props_on_map_load
summary: Refreshes all prop groups, farm event props, seasonal variants, and optionally clears dynamic props on map transition.

name: p11_evt_init_scene_prop_slot
summary: Initializes a 0x18-byte scene prop slot with type_id, item_id, XYZ position, and sets active bit 1.

name: p11_evt_clear_scene_prop_slots
summary: Clears active bit 1, item/type IDs, and XYZ fields across count consecutive 0x18-byte scene prop slots.

name: p11_evt_spawn_dynamic_prop_by_id
summary: Spawns dynamic prop slot 100/101 (g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr) or 0xe8/0x122..0x124 (g_npc_evt_scene_props_map_spawn_lut32) with world pose and type.

name: p11_evt_get_scene_prop_pose
summary: Reads XYZ position and rotation for prop_id (100/101 in g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr or 0xe8/0x122..0x124 in g_npc_evt_scene_props_map_spawn_lut32).

name: p11_evt_set_house_prop_visible
summary: Finds prop_id in g_npc_evt_house_prop_visible_upgrade_cfg (13 entries) and sets or clears its active visibility bit 1.

name: p11_evt_sync_beehive_or_tree_props
summary: Syncs field prop slots 2..3 using g_farm_field_deliver_newborn_animals_evt_count and p11_field_check_breeding_slot_status status into p11_evt_set_field_prop_slot_item.

name: p11_evt_try_throw_held_item_at_prop
summary: Handles dropping/throwing held item onto valid interactive prop slot_ptr and clears prop active bit 1.

name: p11_evt_try_place_held_item_in_bin
summary: Checks held item spatial bounds against (max_w, max_h) and deposits item into shipping/bin prop via p11_ovl_spawn_seasonal_fx_sprite.

name: p11_evt_try_feed_silo_or_deliver_prop
summary: Handles fodder/feed prop 0x174 trigger bit 0x20 or deposits fodder via p11_evt_add_fodder_count and p11_ovl_spawn_seasonal_fx_sprite.

name: p11_evt_check_player_touch_prop_box
summary: Tests player_pos XYZ against g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr (+/-200 XZ, +/-20 Y); sets g_npc_execute_player_action_evt_tick_state = 3 and returns slot ptr on hit.

name: p11_evt_tick_active_prop_timer
summary: Decrements g_npc_execute_player_action_evt_tick_state while g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr+4 bit 0x100 is active and unpaused, clearing bit 0x100 at zero.

name: p11_evt_set_farm_props_disabled_flag
summary: Sets or clears disable bit 0x4000 across all 16 farm prop entries starting at g_npc_evt_props_disabled_flag_count_cfg.

name: p11_evt_count_enabled_farm_props
summary: Counts enabled farm prop slots (bit 0x4000 cleared) across the 16 entries at g_npc_evt_props_disabled_flag_count_cfg.

name: p11_evt_try_place_power_berry_prop
summary: Stores seasonal prop/treasure ID 0x51..0x55 in g_npc_item_pickup_carry_evt_decay_counter when g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 2 is set and slot is empty.

name: p11_evt_decay_seasonal_prop_stamina
summary: Clears expired seasonal prop IDs in g_npc_item_pickup_carry_evt_decay_counter across seasons and deducts 5 stamina from g_core_player_state_pad_0x16.

name: p11_evt_clear_seasonal_prop_id
summary: Clears seasonal prop/treasure ID g_npc_item_pickup_carry_evt_decay_counter back to zero.

name: p11_evt_reset_horse_prop_anchor
summary: Resets secondary prop slot at g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr+0x18 to type 1 at (-1200, 0, 2900) and updates g_npc_evt_horse_prop_anchor_primary_value.

name: p11_evt_reset_primary_prop_anchor
summary: Resets primary prop slot g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr to type 1 at (-5000, 0, 2300) and updates g_npc_evt_horse_prop_anchor_primary_value.

name: p11_evt_poll_dog_horse_prop_proximity
summary: Checks player proximity (p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget) against special props 100 and 0x65 via 0x800f44b4, resetting carried/dropped prop state via 0x800f4cec/cac/fc8.

name: p11_evt_step_thrown_prop_physics
summary: Updates thrown/dropped prop arc physics on g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr, casts floor ray (0x800bdce8), projects camera coordinates (0x800bdb88), and settles via 0x800f4fc8/cec.

name: p11_evt_clear_thrown_prop_state
summary: Clears bit 0x2000000 in g_npc_event_progress_flags, clears bit 1 on g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr+0x1c, and zeroes g_gfx_hud_villager_timers_evt_value.

name: p11_evt_set_field_prop_slot_item
summary: Sets visibility bit 1 and item ID (0xe8 or 0x123) on field prop slot at g_farm_field_plot_slot_growth_stage+slot_idx*0x18+0xf0.

name: p11_evt_apply_season_to_all_prop_groups
summary: Applies seasonal variant item IDs across all 19 scene prop groups in g_farm_field_plot_slot/g_npc_evt_refresh_all_scene_apply_counter.

name: p11_evt_select_state_variant_id
summary: Selects variant item ID based on priority mask bits 0x2000, 0x0800, and 0x1000 in flags.

name: p11_evt_apply_season_prop_variants
summary: Updates seasonal variant item IDs across count prop entries at slot_base via p11_evt_select_state_variant_id.

name: p11_evt_update_house_upgrade_prop_visibility
summary: Updates active bit 1 across 13 prop entries at g_npc_evt_house_prop_visible_upgrade_cfg using season g_farm_calendar_clock, g_farm_upgrade_flags2, and g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags.

name: p11_evt_refresh_prop_active_bits
summary: Synchronizes active bit 1 across count 0x18-byte prop entries using override flags 0x20 and 0x40.

name: p11_evt_update_farm_event_props
summary: Updates visibility of weather, dog, beehive, and festival booths in farm scene prop tables.

name: p11_evt_toggle_prop_slot_by_flag
summary: Looks up prop_id in slot_base and toggles active bit 1 depending on (flag_val & mask) != 0.

name: p11_evt_find_prop_slot_by_id
summary: Searches count consecutive 0x18-byte prop slots at slot_base for matching item ID at +2.

name: p11_evt_apply_festival_prop_overrides
summary: Copies festival prop position overrides from g_npc_evt_apply_festival_prop_value/cc0/d60 into g_farm_field_plot_slot_flags using g_farm_weather_festival.

name: p11_evt_get_season_prop_mask
summary: Returns season bitmask (2, 4, 8, or 0x10) corresponding to current season g_farm_calendar_clock.

name: p11_evt_is_screen_pos_visible
summary: Checks if projected screen coordinates fall within padded 320x240 viewport bounds (-49..369, -49..289).

name: hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos
summary: Projects NPC world position via hm_gte_project_svector_to_ot for speech/heart icon placement

name: p11_evt_draw_map_prop_bubble_icons
summary: Selects per-map icon handler for map ID *(s16 *)(g_core_event_script_ctx + 10) and renders prop bubble icons (0x800f5bc0) over g_npc_evt_map_prop_bubble_value, g_npc_active_script_entity_ptr, and g_npc_evt_scene_props_map_spawn_lut32.

name: p11_evt_draw_world_prop_bubble_icons
summary: Projects active seasonal world props into screen space and submits bubble/icon quads from g_gfx_spr_render_outdoor_field_greenhouse_table via icon_selector_cb.

name: p11_dlg_dispatch_hud_and_menu_ui
summary: Master overlay 11 HUD/UI tick and render dispatcher invoking 0x8002470c(0), 0x800f67e0..0x801038e4, hm_ovl11_draw_town_map_overlay, and 0x8011f5bc.

name: p11_dlg_stub_hud_hook_a
summary: No-op UI/dialogue callback stub at 0x800f6630 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_stub_hud_hook_b
summary: No-op UI/dialogue callback stub at 0x800f6638 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_stub_hud_hook_c
summary: No-op UI/dialogue callback stub at 0x800f6640 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_stub_always_ready
summary: Dialogue/UI state probe stub returning constant 1 in overlay 11.

name: p11_dlg_exit_to_game_substate
summary: Returns from overlay 11 UI/dialogue substate by calling hm_ovl11_set_game_substate.

name: p11_dlg_reset_menu_and_icon_cache
summary: Resets menu state variables g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state..52 and g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_preload_state, then clears the dynamic icon cache.

name: p11_dlg_open_shipping_memo_menu
summary: Resets UI/icon cache, enters menu mode g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state = 6, sets event flag 0x71, and locks game state.

name: p11_dlg_open_farm_ledger_menu
summary: Resets UI/icon cache, enters menu mode g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state = 7, sets event flag 0x70, and locks game state.

name: p11_dlg_open_tv_menu_window
summary: Resets UI cache, sets menu mode g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state = 4, and opens TV channel selection dialogue 0x37a.

name: hm_ovl11_render_hud_clock_and_stamina
summary: Draws in-game HUD clock, season/weekday icon, weather badge, and gold/tool corner widgets

name: p11_dlg_clear_icon_vram_cache
summary: Clears all 72 dynamic item/icon VRAM cache slots at g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_vram_item_cfg (stride 0x22).

name: p11_dlg_clear_icon_cache_locks
summary: Clears frame-lock bytes across all 72 dynamic icon cache slots at g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_cache_lru_count.

name: p11_dlg_load_item_icon_to_vram
summary: Decompresses and uploads item_id icon texture and CLUT to VRAM and registers slot in g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_vram_item_cfg.

name: p11_dlg_draw_cached_item_or_empty_slot
summary: Draws an empty inventory slot background via 0x800f7010 when pos_x == 0 (or zero/empty), otherwise draws the cached item icon via 0x800f8cf8.

name: p11_dlg_draw_lru_item_icon
summary: Draws an item icon using LRU VRAM slot cache g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_vram_item_cfg/fd4 (preloading via 0x800f6a24 when uncached), or draws empty slot background via 0x800f7010.

name: p11_dlg_draw_cached_item_icon
summary: Draws cached item icon sprite via p11_ui_draw_scaled_icon_poly_ft4, loading item_id into free g_npc_dlg_cached_item_empty_lru_count cache slot on cache miss.

name: p11_dlg_draw_offset_ui_sprite
summary: Translates UI sprite coordinates by (+0xc, +0x18) and submits sprite draw via evt_res_draw_cursor_hand.

name: p11_dlg_draw_menu_selection_cursor
summary: Draws animated UI selection cursor frame (anim 0xb, frame 0) from g_gfx_sprite_ot_ctx at (pos_x, pos_y).

name: p11_dlg_draw_empty_item_slot_bg
summary: Draws empty inventory/menu item slot background quad (anim 0xb, frame 2) from g_gfx_sprite_ot_ctx at (pos_x, pos_y).

name: p11_dlg_draw_item_stack_quantity
summary: Draws 'xNN' two-digit item stack count using sprite anim 10 glyphs in g_gfx_sprite_ot_ctx relative to (pos_x, pos_y).

name: p11_dlg_load_shop_item_icon_sheet
summary: Reads shop/menu item icon sheet slice from AFILE 0 into high-RAM buffer g_gfx_highram_arena_ptr+0x4290.

name: p11_dlg_upload_tv_or_menu_icon_sheet
summary: Parses buffered icon pack in high RAM and uploads item/portrait sprite frames into g_npc_dlg_clear_icon_vram_item_cfg VRAM cache.

name: p11_dlg_reset_or_step_menu_icon_preload
summary: Resets UI menu icon sheet loader state g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_preload_state to 0 when reset_flag == -1, otherwise advances icon preload via 0x800f77f0(1).

name: p11_dlg_step_item_icon_sheet_preload
summary: State machine alternating shop sheet DMA loads (g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_preload_state) and item icon uploads until item_id < 0x13f completes.

name: hm_ovl11_update_shop_or_tv_menu
summary: Drives shop purchase counter, clinic/inn, or TV channel weather/recipe show UI

name: p11_dlg_handle_storage_menu_pad_input
summary: Processes menu controller buttons (g_io_active_pad_buf_ptr+8 masks 0x10/20/40/100) to pick up, place, swap, or discard rucksack, tool, shelf, and fridge items with SFX.

name: p11_dlg_transfer_menu_grid_slot
summary: Transfers, swaps, or merges inventory items between menu grid coordinates (src_x, src_y) and (dst_x, dst_y) via 0x800f82fc, 0x800f7e38, 0x800f7fac, and 0x800f8188.

name: p11_dlg_move_item_to_empty_menu_slot
summary: Moves an item stack from src_slot into an empty destination slot respecting g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state storage container rules via 0x800f8404 and 0x800f9174.

name: p11_dlg_swap_or_merge_menu_item_slots
summary: Swaps or merges two occupied inventory, rucksack, fridge, or tool box slots while checking capacity limits and g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state storage rules.

name: p11_ui_try_merge_shipping_or_bag
summary: Checks item pocket category via p11_ui_classify_item_pocket_kind and merges non-tool items into slot_ptr up to 99.

name: p11_ui_compact_6byte_item_slots
summary: Compacts slot_count 6-byte item slots at slots_base by shifting non-zero entries forward and zeroing vacated slots

name: p11_ui_get_storage_bag_slot_ptr
summary: Maps (slot_idx, page_idx) across storage mode g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_open_state (0, 2, else) to the 6-byte item slot pointer in rucksack or storage

name: p11_ui_classify_item_pocket_kind
summary: Classifies item_id into 0 (empty), 1 (tool 1..8), or 2 (>= 9) for rucksack pocket sorting

name: p11_ui_merge_item_stack_capped_99
summary: Adds stack count at src_slot+4 into dst_slot+4 up to 99, clearing src_slot via p11_spr_clear_item_slot_triple when combined count < 100

name: p11_ui_swap_6byte_item_slots
summary: Swaps two unaligned 6-byte (u32 + u16) item slot records at slot_a_addr and slot_b_addr

name: p11_ui_copy_6byte_item_slot
summary: Copies a 6-byte unaligned (u32 + u16) item slot record from src_slot_addr to dst_slot_addr

name: p11_ui_update_storage_menu_cursor
summary: Navigates storage/fridge/cabinet pocket cursor (g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_shop_counter_tv_storage) and page index (g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_shop_counter_1) and draws slot highlight brackets.

name: p11_ui_show_storage_item_tooltip
summary: Looks up storage bag slot via p11_ui_get_storage_bag_slot_ptr, maps seed 0xa4 to +1000, opens window 3, and closes on confirm.

name: p11_ui_draw_storage_slot_row
summary: Draws a horizontal row of slot_count storage icons starting at slot_start via p11_ui_draw_storage_slot_icon advancing icon_x by 6.

name: p11_ui_draw_storage_slot_icon
summary: Draws empty slot tile or tool/item sprite for storage slot slot_idx plus numeric stack quantity for stackable items.

name: p11_ui_draw_menu_scroll_arrows
summary: Draws animated left (0xd) and right (0xc) menu scroll arrows at Y=0x90 (X=0x7d, 0x115) and steps 4-frame animation timer.

name: p11_ui_draw_storage_unit_qty
summary: Formats selected item count (g_npc_dlg_menu_icon_cache_shop_counter_1+1) and storage capacity (capacity_x8 >> 3) separated by slash text at Y=0x6e.

name: p11_ui_draw_storage_menu_frames
summary: Draws three menu window frames via 0x80022580, animated left/right arrows (0x800f8a3c), and title/body lines.

name: p11_ui_draw_cached_item_icon
summary: Draws background slot via 0x800f7010 then emits centered SPRT + DR_TPAGE primitives for cached VRAM icon g_ui_dlg_item_icon_vram_upload_count_tv_menu..62.

name: p11_ui_draw_scaled_icon_poly_ft4
summary: Allocates and submits a POLY_FT4 primitive (code 0x2c) from g_ui_dlg_item_icon_vram_upload_count_tv_menu sprite table scaled by scale_q12 >> 12

name: p11_ui_sync_swapped_icon_vram_pair
summary: Classifies pocket types of slot_a and slot_b via p11_ui_classify_item_pocket_kind and updates VRAM icon cache when exactly one is kind 2.

name: p11_ui_update_item_vram_icon_cache
summary: Manages 18 active VRAM item icon slots at 0x800a0494 and the 72-slot offscreen VRAM icon cache at 0x80129668 using StoreImage/MoveImage2/LoadImage.

name: p11_ui_sync_held_and_bag_vram_icons
summary: Builds a list of held item plus 16 rucksack/tool item IDs and frees unused cached VRAM icon slots in 0x800a0494.

name: p11_ui_reset_inventory_subpanel_state
summary: Resets g_ui_inventory_subpanel_state_open_calendar_state_rucksack_panel and g_ui_inventory_subpanel_state_open_calendar_state_1 to 0 and sets g_ui_inventory_subpanel_state_open_calendar_state_2 = 1

name: p11_ui_open_rucksack_inventory_panel
summary: Resets inventory subpanel state, captures current day and dialog mode flags, plays SFX 3, and activates subpanel state 1.

name: p11_ui_step_calendar_overlay_sm
summary: Steps the farm calendar overlay state machine g_ui_inventory_subpanel_state_open_calendar_state_rucksack_panel, updating calendar input/render or closing back via hm_ovl11_set_game_substate.

name: p11_ui_update_calendar_month_view
summary: Updates calendar month grid, cursor navigation, and event description or prompt state via p11_ui_draw_calendar_month_grid and p11_ui_poll_inventory_menu_input.

name: p11_ui_poll_inventory_menu_input
summary: Polls controller buttons when inventory dialogue input is ready, cancelling subpanel on Cross/Start or entering state 2 on Circle.

name: p11_ui_update_calendar_month_cursor
summary: Moves calendar day cursor g_ui_inventory_subpanel_state_open_calendar_state_1 within [0,29] via +/-1 and +/-7 D-pad wrapping and renders cursor via p11_ui_draw_calendar_cursor.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_month_grid
summary: Draws full calendar UI: weekday header bar, month/season title, 30 day numbers, festival icons, villager birthdays, and scheduled events.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_season_birthdays
summary: Scans 18 villager birthday entries at g_ui_calendar_season_birthdays_show_value and draws birthday badges via 0x800fa590 for matching season_idx.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_scheduled_event
summary: Draws special scheduled calendar event badge via 0x800fa5c8 when g_npc_trigger_cutscene_script_evt_scheduled_counter != -1 matches year_idx and season_idx.

name: p11_ui_show_recipe_or_item_desc
summary: Matches category pair against 18 entries at 0x80126f8c (or special 0x80071cc0 combo 0x3dd, default 0x3dc) and opens window 3.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_cursor
summary: Maps calendar grid cell (season_idx, day_idx) via p11_ui_calc_calendar_grid_cell_xy and draws cursor hand offset (+0xc, +9).

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_festival_badge
summary: Draws festival badge sprite index 0 at calendar grid cell (season_idx, day_idx) via 0x800fa600.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_birthday_badge
summary: Draws villager birthday badge sprite index 1 at calendar grid cell (season_idx, day_idx) via 0x800fa600.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_event_badge
summary: Draws special event badge sprite index 2 at calendar grid cell (season_idx, day_idx) via 0x800fa600.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_cell_badge
summary: Selects badge sprite entry icon_idx from 0x80126fd4, computes calendar cell screen position via p11_ui_calc_calendar_grid_cell_xy, and draws quad.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_header_date
summary: Draws 1-based day number, separator, seasonal icon via 0x80024a10, and season label via 0x8001aa7c at calendar Y=0x34.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_month_days
summary: Draws calendar day numbers 1..30 across month grid coloring Sundays red (2) and Saturdays blue (1) via p11_ui_draw_calendar_day_number.

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_day_number
summary: Draws 1-based day number at calendar cell (day_idx, row_idx) using red (5) for mode 1 or blue (4) for mode 2.

name: p11_ui_calc_calendar_grid_cell_xy
summary: Computes 7-column calendar cell screen coordinates (out_x, out_y) at 30 + col*41 and 80 + row*14

name: p11_ui_draw_calendar_weekday_bar
summary: Draws weekday bar frame and all 7 weekday labels (Sun in red 4, Sat in blue 5) spaced 0x29 px apart along Y=0x42.

name: p11_ui_reset_calendar_cursor_state
summary: Zeroes g_ui_calendar_cursor_state_open_tick_state..e8 and sets g_ui_calendar_cursor_state_rucksack_state_2 = 0xff for calendar cursor state

name: p11_ui_open_rucksack_pause_menu
summary: Opens the rucksack pause menu from idle state 0 by calling p11_ui_reset_calendar_cursor_state, setting state 1, and playing SFX 3.

name: p11_ui_tick_rucksack_pause_menu
summary: Draws dark backdrop panel, exits pause menu on state 3, or runs hm_ovl11_run_rucksack_pause_menu and updates equipped tool state.

name: hm_ovl11_run_rucksack_pause_menu
summary: Renders and handles input for the player rucksack, tool pocket, and item equip menu

name: p11_ui_show_rucksack_item_desc
summary: Opens dialogue window 3 for rucksack item *slot_ptr (translating 0xa4 via 0x800d60d4+1000) and resets 0x80126fe0 when dismissed.

name: p11_ui_move_or_swap_rucksack_slots
summary: Moves, swaps, or merges up to 99 identical items between rucksack slots src_slot and dst_slot using p11_ui_get_rucksack_slot_ptr.

name: p11_ui_try_swap_rucksack_tool_slot
summary: Validates tool slot eligibility via p11_ui_is_rucksack_active_equip_slot and p11_spr_is_item_edible_or_holdable, swapping 6-byte slots via p11_ui_swap_rucksack_6byte_slots

name: p11_ui_try_swap_rucksack_item_slots
summary: Validates both rucksack slots via p11_ui_is_rucksack_active_equip_slot, p11_spr_is_item_edible_or_holdable, and p11_spr_get_item_shipping_value_tier, swapping via p11_ui_swap_rucksack_6byte_slots

name: p11_ui_try_stack_rucksack_slot
summary: Checks item kind via 0x800d583c, stacks src_slot_ptr into slot_ptr up to 99 when stackable (kind 2), and returns true if not stacked.

name: p11_ui_is_rucksack_active_equip_slot
summary: Returns 1 if rucksack slot_idx is 0 (equipped tool) or 9 (held item), else 0

name: p11_ui_merge_rucksack_stack_capped_99
summary: Merges rucksack item quantity at src_slot+4 into dst_slot+4 up to 99, clearing src_slot via p11_spr_clear_item_slot_triple when total < 100

name: p11_ui_swap_rucksack_6byte_slots
summary: Swaps two unaligned 6-byte rucksack item or tool slots at slot_a_addr and slot_b_addr

name: p11_ui_get_rucksack_slot_ptr
summary: Maps rucksack slot_idx (0 -> g_core_player_state_action_sub_vars_idx10, 9 -> g_player_equipped_tool_slot, else 6-byte stride) to its u16 slot pointer

name: p11_ui_draw_rucksack_slot_icon
summary: Renders empty rucksack background via 0x800f7010 or item sprite via hm_ovl11_spawn_render_entity with quantity digits for kind-2 items.

name: p11_ui_enable_hud_clock_overlay
summary: Sets g_ui_enable_hud_clock_overlay_disable_state = 1 when currently zero to enable HUD clock/overlay display

name: p11_ui_disable_hud_clock_overlay
summary: Clears g_ui_enable_hud_clock_overlay_disable_state = 0 when non-zero to hide HUD clock/overlay display

name: p11_ui_draw_hud_clock_if_enabled
summary: Invokes p11_ui_draw_hud_clock_widget when HUD clock visibility state g_ui_enable_hud_clock_overlay_disable_state is nonzero.

name: p11_ui_draw_hud_clock_widget
summary: Draws top-right HUD clock box at (0xe4, 0x10) showing season icon, colored day/weekday, AM/PM, hour/minute, and G label.

name: p11_ui_snapshot_farm_status_summary
summary: Populates g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_trigger_open_counter..74 and g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_screen_value..e8 status summary cache with upgrades, recipes, family/pets, animal/memo counts, rating, and shipped items

name: p11_ui_trigger_stamina_warning_sfx
summary: Sets g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_trigger_open_counter = 1 and plays warning SFX via hm_res_cd_wait_load_sync(10, 0, 2) once when flag is zero

name: p11_ui_open_farm_status_screen
summary: Snapshots farm status summary, streams A-file 0xe into arena scratch, unpacks VRAM, and initializes 5 status screen sprites.

name: p11_ui_dispatch_farm_status_state
summary: Polls pad input, renders frame background for farm status states 3..5, and dispatches states 1..6 via g_ui_dispatch_status_state_jtbl_ptr.

name: p11_ui_update_farm_status_screen
summary: Draws farm status border and tabs (0x800fe640), handles L/R page switching, exits on button press via 0x800fc320, and draws active page.

name: p11_ui_close_farm_status_screen
summary: Plays confirm/close SFX 3, initiates fade-out via 0x800132f0(10,0,2), and transitions farm status state 0x8012720c to 5.

name: p11_ui_draw_status_overview_page
summary: Draws Farm Status overview page: farmer name/hearts, tool/lumber stats, family hearts, gold, animals, Power Berries, and records.

name: p11_ui_draw_sprite_with_label
summary: Submits a status sprite quad from g_ui_open_status_screen_overview_sprite_value[icon_bank] at (x, y) alongside its text label at (x+0x18, y+4).

name: p11_ui_draw_status_record_counts
summary: Draws 4 farm record counters from g_ui_status_record_counts_count at X=0xd4 using p11_ui_draw_sprite_with_label.

name: p11_ui_draw_status_animal_counts
summary: Draws 5 farm animal total counts from g_ui_status_animal_counts_count at X=0x8c using p11_ui_draw_sprite_with_label.

name: p11_ui_draw_status_family_hearts
summary: Draws up to 4 family/pet status entries from g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_family_cfg with affection hearts via p11_ui_draw_sprite_label_and_hearts.

name: p11_ui_draw_sprite_label_and_hearts
summary: Submits animal/resident sprite quad, text label at (x+0x18, y+2), and gold heart row via 0x800fe834 at (x+0x60, y+0x10).

name: p11_ui_draw_power_berry_icons
summary: Loops over 6 Power Berry / Mystic Berry bitmasks in 0x80127328 against g_npc_event_progress_flags and draws earned icons.

name: p11_ui_draw_shipped_items_page
summary: Renders 21 shipped-item sprites in a 3x7 grid from g_ui_shipped_items_page_value_1 alongside capped 999 counts via p11_ui_draw_capped_999_count.

name: p11_ui_draw_capped_999_count
summary: Clamps count at 999, formats 3-digit script string into g_ui_status_overview_page_record_animal_counter, and draws it at (x, y).

name: p11_ui_draw_chicken_coop_list_page
summary: Draws chicken page header badge (0) and 7-row scrollable list (0x800fcbb4) for g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_chicken_counter chickens.

name: p11_ui_draw_chicken_coop_row
summary: Finds row_num-th active chicken in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl and draws index, sprite, name, hearts, and status metrics.

name: p11_ui_draw_barn_cow_list_page
summary: Draws livestock cow page header badge (1) and 7-row scrollable list (0x800fcd40) for g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_barn_counter_cow_list cows.

name: p11_ui_draw_barn_cow_row
summary: Finds row_num-th active cow (IDs 0x160..0x163) in g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl and draws index, sprite, hearts, and status.

name: p11_ui_draw_barn_sheep_list_page
summary: Draws livestock sheep page header badge (2) and 7-row scrollable list (0x800fced4) for g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_barn_counter_sheep_list sheep.

name: p11_ui_draw_barn_sheep_row
summary: Finds row_num-th active sheep (IDs 0x164..0x166) in g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl and draws index, sprite, hearts, and status.

name: p11_ui_draw_scrollable_7row_list
summary: Scrolls g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_screen_scrollable_counter across item_count entries via D-pad Up/Down, draws scroll arrows, and calls draw_row_cb for 7 visible rows.

name: p11_ui_draw_farm_animal_page_badge
summary: Submits animal page header icon from g_ui_animal_page_badge_value_2 at (0xba, 0x14) with unit string at (0xd2, 0x1a).

name: p11_ui_draw_animal_status_row
summary: Builds formatted animal status line with optional star glyph 0x90, age/count metrics, and badge icon at (x+0x10, y).

name: p11_ui_draw_harvest_sprites_page
summary: Draws Harvest Sprites status page title and iterates indices 0..6 calling 0x800fd3cc for each sprite row.

name: p11_ui_draw_harvest_sprite_row
summary: Draws Harvest Sprite row (g_ui_harvest_sprite_row_table) with index, name/hearts, gift icon, and favorite skill tier + count.

name: p11_ui_draw_earnings_summary_page
summary: Draws cumulative farm income/expense totals (g_ui_villager_heart_level_earnings_seasonal_table/1200) and all 4 seasonal balance gauges via p11_ui_draw_seasonal_balance_row.

name: p11_ui_draw_seasonal_balance_row
summary: Draws seasonal icon, income/expense bar via 0x800fd968, and summary rating text from g_ui_shop_tv_menu_seasonal_portrait_table at X=0xac.

name: p11_ui_draw_income_expense_bar
summary: Draws split horizontal income/expense gauge around X=0x68 and 10,000G overflow icon counts at y.

name: p11_ui_draw_sprite_status_rows
summary: Renders the 5 Harvest Sprite status rows from g_core_player_state_tool_exp_and_timers_idx3 with face icons, star tiers, EXP progress bars, and percentages.

name: p11_ui_update_sprite_row_rank
summary: Looks up base ID from g_ui_sprite_row_rank_table for clamped row_idx (<=4) and calls p11_ui_find_tool_or_sprite_rank_idx.

name: p11_ui_find_tool_or_sprite_rank_idx
summary: Scans 5 consecutive rank flags starting at base_id using g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter threshold to compute a signed 1..5 progress index.

name: p11_ui_is_npc_affection_rank_active
summary: Forwards npc_id to hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection(npc_id, 0, 2, 0) to query status rank bits for the sprite/tool status page.

name: p11_ui_matches_tool_sprite_rank
summary: Returns true when g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter equals target_val

name: p11_ui_draw_affection_face_icon
summary: Clamps affection level to [0,4] and submits heart/face sprite quad from 0x8012737c at screen position (x, y).

name: p11_ui_draw_tool_upgrade_tier_stars
summary: Draws up to 4 tool upgrade tier icons spaced 8 px apart horizontally whenever exp_val meets thresholds in 0x80127214.

name: p11_ui_draw_tool_exp_progress_bar
summary: Renders a bordered 0x82x7 tool experience bar with background fill and tier-colored gradient proportional to exp_val.

name: p11_ui_draw_tool_exp_percent
summary: Formats tool upgrade percentage relative to g_ui_tool_upgrade_tier_stars_exp_value thresholds (or MAX/empty strings) and draws text at (x, y).

name: p11_ui_read_slot_s16_value
summary: Dereferences and sign-extends *slot_ptr to int for HUD status slot queries

name: p11_ui_draw_left_trimmed_int
summary: Formats integer num as 14-glyph buffer, trims leading 0xffd spaces, and draws the number at (x, y).

name: p11_ui_init_portrait_pair_from_table
summary: Writes g_ui_shop_tv_menu_seasonal_portrait_table[table_idx] into out_pair[0] and 0xffff sentinel into out_pair[1]

name: p11_ui_draw_status_page_tabs
summary: Submits left (0) and right (2) status page tab arrows at X=0x20 and X=0x108, Y=0x18 using 30-frame blink phase.

name: p11_ui_draw_status_scroll_up_arrow
summary: Submits upward scroll arrow sprite 1 at (0x120, 0x30) using 30-frame blink phase from g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_screen_page_counter.

name: p11_ui_draw_status_scroll_down_arrow
summary: Submits downward scroll arrow sprite 3 at (0x120, 200) using 30-frame blink phase from g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_screen_page_counter.

name: p11_ui_draw_red_hearts_rtl
summary: Draws count red affection hearts right-to-left from (start_x, y) using sprite frame 5 via 0x800fe86c.

name: p11_ui_draw_gold_hearts_rtl
summary: Draws count gold hearts right-to-left from (start_x, y) using sprite frame 4 via 0x800fe86c.

name: p11_ui_draw_heart_row_rtl
summary: Submits count heart/status quads of frame_idx stepping leftward by 8 pixels per icon starting from (start_x, y).

name: p11_ui_next_status_book_page
summary: Advances g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_screen_next_counter across pages 0..7, skipping empty chicken (2), cow (3), and sheep (4) pages via coop/barn counters

name: p11_ui_prev_status_book_page
summary: Decrements g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_screen_next_counter across pages 7..0, skipping empty sheep (4), cow (3), and chicken (2) pages via coop/barn counters

name: p11_ui_count_shipped_or_memo_entries

name: p11_ui_draw_staged_ingredients_grid

name: p11_ui_draw_cooking_source_pocket

name: p11_ui_consume_selected_ingredients

name: p11_ui_consume_one_ingredient

name: p11_ui_kitchen_show_failed_msg

name: p11_ui_exit_kitchen_cooking_menu

name: p11_ovl_set_entity_state_pair

name: p11_ovl_tick_unpaused_timer

name: p11_ovl_draw_countdown_fx_quad

name: p11_ovl_step_livestock_anim_wrapper
summary: Wrapper invoking p11_animl_tv_reset_broadcast_state during hm_ovl11_frame_render_and_sim and overlay state transitions

name: p11_ovl_activate_tv_anim_state

name: p11_evt_tick_tv_and_diary_substate

name: p11_animl_tv_select_channel_slot
