summary: Checks whether animal_rec is positioned inside barn/target zone 5 via p11_field_wait_animal_zone_dwell(animal_rec, 5, 0) and returns true if non-zero.

name: p11_field_step_animal_to_slot
summary: Sets animal target slot via p11_field_set_seek_arrival_radius, steps movement via p11_animl_sprite_step_move_collision, preserves bit 0x800 on animal_rec+0x34, and clears velocity via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags(4, animal_rec+0x48, 0) upon arrival when flag 0x2000 clears.

name: p11_field_get_animal_target_cell_center
summary: Resolves a pasture/barn/coop grid slot via p11_field_find_random_matching_field_tile, converts its tile coordinates to world position via p11_spr_tile_coords_to_world_pos, and writes the coordinates via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters.

name: p11_field_find_random_matching_field_tile
summary: Starts at a random tile via hm_prng_next in g_farm_field_grid (45x25) or greenhouse g_farm_greenhouse_grid (7x7) and scans wraparound using predicate p11_field_is_tile_active_crop_stage/p11_field_is_tile_tall_grass/p11_field_is_tile_weed_or_grass, returning tile coordinates on match (0) or 1 if none found.

name: p11_field_is_tile_active_crop_stage
summary: Checks tile via p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop, excludes grass/special ranges (0x31..0x35, 0x178..0x179), and returns 1 when the tile growth byte matches its max stage descriptor in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr/g_gfx_grid_collision_spr_crop_lut32.

name: p11_field_is_tile_tall_grass
summary: Checks tile via p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop and returns 1 if the secondary tile ID at tile_ptr+2 is 0x168 or 0x16a (cuttable grass/weed).

name: p11_field_is_tile_weed_or_grass
summary: Checks tile via p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop and returns 1 if the secondary tile ID at tile_ptr+2 is 0x168, 0x169, 0x16a, or 0x16b.

name: p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop
summary: Verifies *tile_ptr is an active crop via hm_ovl11_is_entity_slot_active and returns true when *tile_ptr is not grass (0x36).

name: p11_field_pick_random_eligible_animal
summary: Scans chicken coop g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl or barn livestock g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (plus pregnant/special slots g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_sync_cfg16/6206 and NPC actor jobs) matching target_zone and filter_flags (fed/produce/sick), returning a random index via hm_prng_next.

name: p11_field_get_barn_stall_pos
summary: Computes indoor barn stall XYZ coordinates from g_farm_field_barn_stall_pos_value_1/64/68 for livestock slot_idx (0..0x15, including pregnant slots 0x14/0x15).

name: p11_field_get_coop_perch_pos
summary: Computes coop perch XYZ coordinates from g_farm_field_coop_perch_pos_value_1/c4/c8 at 400-unit X spacing for chicken slot_idx.

name: p11_field_clear_animal_bubble_state
summary: Resets animal emote bubble ID (+0xb6) and timer pointer (+0xdc) in animal_rec to zero.

name: p11_field_place_sprite_in_farm_work_zone
summary: Reads Harvest Sprite spawn XYZ and facing from g_farm_field_place_sprite_work_value_1..ec using sprite ID sprite_actor+0xac, writes +0x38..+0x40 and +0x22, and sets zone +0x30 = 0x28.

name: p11_field_get_harvest_sprite_task_speed
summary: Computes Harvest Sprite task animation/move speed from season g_farm_calendar_clock/day, active chore (+0x26, +0xb8), skill levels (+0xae..+0xb2), and individual modifier g_farm_field_harvest_sprite_task_value.

name: p11_field_get_harvest_sprite_skill_delay
summary: Selects chore skill (+0xae, +0xb0, +0xb2) by Harvest Sprite task state (+0x26 == 8..10) and returns 2 * g_farm_field_harvest_sprite_skill_dbg_count[skill / 0x34] (or 0x18).

name: p11_field_reset_animal_bubble_when_idle
summary: Clears active animal speech/emote timer pointer at animal_rec+0xdc when bubble ID +0xb6 is 0 or when both +0xdc and animal_rec+0x30 are 0 (also zeroing +0xb6).

name: p11_field_dispatch_animal_feed_item
summary: Dispatches item_id in range 0x41..0x124 through jump table g_farm_field_dispatch_animal_feed_jtbl_ptr to handle animal/NPC item gift response, returning -1 if out of range.

name: p11_field_map_treat_item_to_index
summary: Maps specific animal treat/feed/supply item IDs (0x68..0x124) to compact handler indices 0..15, or -1 if unmatched.

name: p11_field_init_sky_daylight_palette
summary: Resets g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_state to 0, computes sunset hour via p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour and day phase via p11_field_get_daylight_phase, and submits initial sky palette gradient to g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_1/g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_2 via gfx_draw_vram_rect_sync.

name: p11_field_update_sky_daylight_palette
summary: Queries sunset hour via p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour(g_farm_calendar_clock) and day phase via p11_field_get_daylight_phase, driving sky tint interpolation in g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_1/g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_2/g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_state via gfx_draw_vram_rect_sync, gfx_queue_vram_clut_upload, and gfx_queue_vram_pix_upload.

name: p11_field_get_daylight_phase
summary: Classifies hour against dawn (5..6) and sunset_hour into daylight phase (0: dawn, 1: day, 2: dusk, 3: night).

name: p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour
summary: Returns sunset hour for the given season index from table g_farm_field_season_sunset_hour_value.

name: p11_field_init_daylight_tint_default
summary: Resets g_farm_field_daylight_tint_default_fade_state to 0 and writes initial ambient RGB triple (0xcf7e, 0x105b, 0x166b) via p11_animl_set_fade_palette_a(0, rgb).

name: p11_field_step_daylight_tint_fade
summary: While event flag 8 is 1, interpolates ambient RGB between g_farm_field_daylight_tint_fade_value_1 and g_farm_field_daylight_tint_fade_value_2 over 0x4b0 steps via hm_clut_lerp_rgb_triple, applies it via p11_animl_set_fade_palette_a, and clears flag 8 when done.

name: p11_field_init_upgrade_and_memo_state
summary: Refreshes memo flags via p11_field_sync_memo_hint_flags_wrapper and zeroes carpenter/upgrade timers g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_grant_counter, g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter, and g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_mark_counter during scene initialization.

name: p11_field_grant_cooking_or_tv_item_gift
summary: Classifies gifted item_id (0x13f..0x141 -> 4, 0xf7..0xf9 or 1..0x19 -> 2) into g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_grant_counter, stores item_id in g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter, and sets event flag 0x37 via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_mark_tv_recipe_watched
summary: Sets TV/cooking state flag g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_mark_counter to 3.

name: p11_field_sync_memo_hint_flags_wrapper
summary: Wrapper that delegates directly to p11_field_refresh_all_memo_hint_flags to recompute all memo and farm tip bitmask flags.

name: p11_field_refresh_all_memo_hint_flags
summary: Refreshes all 12 bitmask flags in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags covering tools, animals, crops, farm upgrades, sprites, and town NPC tips.

name: p11_field_tick_carpenter_upgrade_timer
summary: Decrements daily construction and countdown timers (0x80070d12, 0x80070d10, 0x800719fc) and completes Gotz farm building upgrades (coop, barn, house 1/2, greenhouse) when timers expire.

name: p11_field_consume_pending_unlock_notice
summary: Queries or consumes the pending farm upgrade/building completion code in g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter (modes 0, 1, 2), applying coop/barn upgrades 0x13f..0x141 and refreshing memo flags.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit2_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 2 (0x4) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in g_farm_field_refresh_recipe_bit2_value have affection > 100 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count, and sets bit 2 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit3_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 3 (0x8) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in g_farm_field_refresh_recipe_bit3_value have affection > 100 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count, and sets bit 3 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit4_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 4 (0x10) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in g_farm_field_refresh_recipe_bit4_value have affection > 100 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count, and sets bit 4 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit0_from_npc5d
summary: Clears bit 0 (0x1) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags and sets it if NPC 0x5d has affection > 0x32 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count(0x5d).

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit1_from_npc5f
summary: Clears bit 1 (0x2) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags and sets it if NPC 0x5f has affection > 0x32 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count(0x5f).

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_5_to_7
summary: Updates recipe/memo hint bits 0x20, 0x40, and 0x80 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags from g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 0x800, equipped tool g_player_equipped_tool, and g_farm_field_tick_carpenter_upgrade_refresh_counter.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit8_high_affection
summary: Clears bit 0x100 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, then sets it when g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 0x200000 is clear and any NPC in g_npc_actor_tbl_base (37 entries stride 0x1d4) has affection > 50000.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_9_to_13
summary: Sets milestone memo bits 0x200..0x2000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags for the earliest missing upgrade among coop, house 1, barn, house 2, and greenhouse (g_farm_weather_festival..0c).

name: p11_field_update_goddess_memo_flag
summary: Clears bit 0x4000 of g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags and sets it when hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection(0x1e, 0, 2, 0) indicates the Harvest Goddess gift condition is unmet.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_15_to_17
summary: Sets memo bits 0x8000, 0x10000, or 0x20000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags based on coop/barn upgrades (g_farm_upgrade_flags0/0a) and progress flags g_npc_event_progress_flags (0x100, 0x200, 0x100000).

name: p11_field_update_town_npc_memo_flags
summary: Updates bits 0x40000, 0x80000, and 0x100000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags by querying hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection for NPCs 0x1c, 0x1a, and 0x1b.

name: p11_field_update_sprite_memo_flags
summary: Updates bits 0x200000 and 0x400000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags by querying hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection for NPCs 0x1f and 0x20.

name: p11_field_reset_family_milestone_state
summary: Clears g_farm_field_family_milestone_state_record_counter, sets g_farm_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_counter to 0xffff, and sets event flag 0x1b via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_record_marriage_spouse
summary: Maps bachelorette spouse_npc_id (3, 7, 9, 0xe) to index 0..4 in g_farm_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_counter, saves spouse ID in g_core_calendar_event_flags_daily_scene_counter, zeroes g_farm_field_family_milestone_state_record_counter, and latches wedding date into g_npc_evt_pet_horse_naming_field_cfg..afd4.

name: p11_field_record_wedding_anniversary_date
summary: Saves current day g_farm_cal_day and season g_farm_calendar_clock into g_core_calendar_event_flags_execute_field_cfg16/g_core_calendar_event_flags_execute_field_count, clears pregnancy flag 0x4e via hm_event_flag_set, and resets g_farm_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_counter to 0.

name: p11_field_update_spouse_daily_chores
summary: When marriage event flag 0x41 is set via hm_event_flag_get, selects spouse actor g_npc_actor_tbl_base + g_core_calendar_event_flags_daily_scene_counter*0x1d4, calls p11_field_track_spouse_talk_neglect_days/ab4/c98, and if flag 0x4f is set updates baby via p11_field_update_baby_growth_stage(&g_farm_field_spouse_daily_chores_value).

name: p11_field_get_spouse_profile_ptr
summary: Returns pointer from g_farm_field_spouse_profile_dat_ptr indexed by active spouse slot g_farm_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_counter.

name: p11_field_advance_spouse_pregnancy_timer
summary: When baby born flag 0x4f is clear, advances days-married counter g_farm_field_advance_spouse_pregnancy_cfg16 up to 0x1e, then sets pregnancy flag 0x4e once spouse affection (+4) >= 65000 and advances g_farm_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_counter.

name: p11_field_update_baby_growth_stage
summary: Increments baby age g_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_cfg16_baby_growth up to 300 and updates growth stage g_core_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_state and event flags 0x50 (infant < 60), 0x51 (crawling < 120), and 0x52 (toddler).

name: p11_field_track_spouse_talk_neglect_days
summary: Increments g_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_counter when daily spouse talk flag 0x4b is 0 (resets to 0 if spoken), then clears daily spouse flags 0x4b and 0x4c via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_check_spouse_low_affection_sick
summary: If spouse affection (+4) drops below 0x3a99 and event flag 0x2b is clear, sets flags 0x4d and 0xaf via hm_event_flag_set and increments g_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_cfg16_spouse_low up to 3.

name: p11_field_reset_all_mine_floors
summary: Clears all 10 floors (10x10 bytes each) of mine state in g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_trigger_table and reset flags g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_dig_flag.., then zeroes g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_state and floor counter g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter.

name: p11_field_check_player_on_mine_stairs
summary: Maps player coordinates to a 10x10 mine cell via p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile and calls p11_field_trigger_mine_stairs_prompt to test for up-stairs on the previous floor or down-stairs on the current floor.

name: p11_field_trigger_mine_stairs_prompt
summary: Checks if the mine tile at (grid_x, grid_y) on floor_idx holds stairs (type 2), sets transition flags in 0x8012d510 and event flag 3, opens dialogue box, and ends player action lock.

name: p11_field_cache_mine_grid_pointers
summary: Scans the 10x10 mine floor grid (-0x708..+X, 0x708..-Z, step 400), caches tile pointers with flag bit 3 into 0x8009e5f8, sets mine base drop rate to 10, and clears bit 0x2000 of 0x8012d510.

name: p11_field_populate_mine_floor_tiles
summary: Iterates the 10x10 mine floor grid at g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_trigger_table + g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter*100 and spawns rocks/stumps (type 1) or ladder (type 2) at each cell via p11_field_apply_mine_tile_decal.

name: p11_field_apply_mine_tile_decal
summary: Writes mine floor tile decal bytes/UVs from g_farm_field_apply_mine_tile_flag_1..g_farm_field_apply_mine_tile_value[decal_kind*10] into map polygon descriptor referenced by g_farm_cache_field_tile_pointers_spr_value when walkable bit 8 is set.

name: p11_field_dig_mine_floor_tile
summary: Converts the hoe-target coordinate ahead of the player to a 10x10 mine tile via p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile, reveals stairs down on RNG hit, or rolls an ore/item find via p11_field_roll_mine_ore_or_powerberry.

name: p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile
summary: Converts world XZ position to 10x10 mine grid indices (400-unit cells centered at -2000, +2000), returning 2/3 if out of bounds or bit 8 test on g_farm_cache_field_tile_pointers_spr_value.

name: p11_field_tick_mine_stairs_confirm
summary: Ticks the active mine exit/descend confirmation prompt in 0x8012d510, warping to the waterfall/winter mine entrance on exit or incrementing mine floor g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter on descent.

name: p11_field_roll_mine_ore_or_powerberry
summary: Rolls hm_prng_next(100) against floor-weighted drop table g_farm_field_roll_mine_ore_region/g_farm_field_roll_mine_ore_value_1 for winter/normal mine g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter and gates one-time Power Berry (0x67) or Mystic/item (99) drops via flags 0x60..0x62.

name: p11_field_handle_mine_floor_entry
summary: Checks ladder arrival (g_player_interact_target high u16 == 0x42) or event flag 0x44, places player at ladder tile (g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_counter_spawn_pos, g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_counter_1), clears flag 0x44, and regenerates mine floor via p11_field_set_mine_ladder_spawn_pos.

name: p11_field_set_mine_ladder_spawn_pos
summary: When mine depth g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter != 0, clears bit 0x1000 in g_gfx_active_map_desc_idx2376 and updates entrance spawn g_gfx_active_map_desc_idx2396..ec and ladder coords g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_cfg16_spawn_pos/16 from g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_counter_spawn_pos/1a.

name: p11_ui_init_blacksmith_shop_menu
summary: Populates the 9-entry blacksmith/toolshop menu list in g_ui_hud_selected_idx, gating cheese/butter/yarn makers and sprite/blessing entries on flags.

name: p11_ui_init_poultry_feed_shop_menu
summary: Populates the 4-entry poultry/animal feed shop list in g_ui_hud_selected_idx, gating the fourth entry on g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags bit 0x4000.

name: p11_ui_init_winery_or_inn_shop_menu
summary: Populates two shop sub-lists (g_ui_hud_selected_idx 2 entries, g_ui_hud_sprite_prim up to 4 entries gated by g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags bits 1 and 2).

name: p11_ui_init_supermarket_shop_menu
summary: Populates the 9-entry supermarket catalog in g_ui_hud_selected_idx, toggling entry 0 vs entry 1 based on g_ui_supermarket_shop_menu_redeem_cfg16 bit 0x10.

name: hm_ovl11_draw_earnings_summary_ui
summary: Renders shipping ledger, farm earnings, livestock count, and villager relationship status page

name: p11_ui_purchase_shop_row_item_a
summary: Deducts qty * price from gold via hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level and adds item *(u16 *)(shop_row+8) via p11_evt_add_chicken_feed_count(2, ...)

name: hm_ovl11_draw_memo_and_recipes_ui
summary: Renders kitchen recipe book, shipped items list, and farm memo summary screens

name: p11_ui_purchase_shop_row_item_b
summary: Deducts qty * price from gold via hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level and adds item *(u16 *)(shop_row+8) via p11_evt_add_festival_medal_count(2, ...)

name: p11_ui_run_sell_chicken_dialog_sm
summary: Runs the poultry farm sell-chicken dialogue state machine, pricing mature vs chick birds at 2000G/500G and removing the sold coop record.

name: p11_ui_find_last_flagged_coop_bird
summary: Scans 10 coop animal entries at g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl_idx0_pos_y (stride 0xB4) for flag bit 0x20000, returning last matching index or -1

name: p11_ui_is_last_flagged_bird_ready
summary: Locates last flagged coop bird via p11_ui_find_last_flagged_coop_bird and tests flag bit 0x40 in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl_idx0_pos_y

name: p11_ui_run_clinic_shop_sm
summary: Runs Doctor's clinic shop state machine offering 10G stamina/fatigue checkups (p11_ui_get_stamina_fatigue_icon_id) and medicine purchase submenu.

name: p11_ui_get_stamina_fatigue_icon_id
summary: Maps player stamina g_core_player_state_stamina and fatigue g_core_player_state_pad_0x16 tiers into 5x4 icon lookup table g_ui_stamina_fatigue_icon_lut

name: p11_ui_is_hud_menu_not_state_26
summary: Returns true when UI state g_ui_hud_menu_not_state_tick_state is not equal to 0x1a (26)

name: p11_ui_run_medal_exchange_shop_sm
summary: Runs horse-race festival medal prize exchange state machine checking medal balance and calling p11_ui_redeem_festival_medal_prize.

name: p11_ui_can_afford_medal_prize
summary: Looks up selected prize cost via p11_spr_get_special_item_stamina_heal and compares against g_core_player_state_shipping_or_medals

name: p11_ui_redeem_festival_medal_prize
summary: Subtracts festival medal cost (0x800d740c), grants Power Berry flag 0x10 or 500 lumber (0x800f3898), and transitions shop state.

name: p11_ui_run_animal_picker_dialog
summary: Draws scrollable 4-row animal selector modal for chickens, cows, or sheep, returning selected animal slot index or -2 on cancel.

name: p11_ui_draw_animal_picker_row
summary: Draws animal name, mini heart row (p11_ui_draw_mini_hearts_rtl), formatted age, and species/state badge inside animal selection modal.

name: p11_ui_read_s16_to_int
summary: Dereferences *val_ptr and returns sign-extended int for earnings summary helper p11_ui_draw_animal_picker_row

name: p11_ui_draw_mini_hearts_rtl
summary: Submits count mini heart icons via 0x800245f4 stepping leftward 8 pixels per icon from (start_x, y).

name: p11_ui_count_or_find_animal_by_kind
summary: Counts or finds the target_rank-th chicken (0), cow (1), or sheep (2) across coop/barn tables with optional maturity filter

name: p11_ui_init_saturday_shop_state
summary: Initializes Saturday/festival stall shop state g_ui_saturday_shop_state_value=1, selects slot via p11_ui_find_text_sentinel_len, and resets yes/no cursor.

name: p11_ui_run_saturday_shop_sm
summary: Runs the Saturday shop dialogue state machine gating on weekday == 6, charging 10G entry, and calling p11_ui_buy_power_berry_or_special.

name: p11_ui_find_text_sentinel_len
summary: Scans up to 9 bytes in string buffer for 0x02 sentinel byte, returning match offset or -1.

name: p11_ui_reset_shop_text_render_mode
summary: Resets dialogue box state via evt_res_set_dialog_fade_flag(0) and hm_text_set_render_mode(0)

name: p11_ui_poll_shop_confirm_box
summary: Waits for dialogue state 5 and delegates to p11_ui_run_yes_no_prompt_box at (0x83, 0x48) to confirm or cancel purchase.

name: p11_ui_buy_power_berry_or_special
summary: Checks cost of item 'rstuvwxyg'[entry_idx] via hm_ovl11_get_entity_anim_state, deducts gold, and sets g_anim_tv_recipe_broadcast_unlock_buy_flag[entry_idx] = 3 and flag entry_idx+0x67

name: p11_ui_setup_inn_day_night_menu
summary: Clears 10-slot list at g_ui_hud_selected_idx and populates Inn daytime (6..17h) or evening shop menu options, icons, and box layout

name: p11_ui_setup_clinic_shop_menu
summary: Clears 10-slot list at g_ui_hud_selected_idx and populates Clinic shop menu options, icons, and dialogue IDs in g_ui_shop_menu_ctx_8012d

name: p11_ui_run_blacksmith_or_tool_shop
summary: Runs 7-state Saibara tool shop / upgrade menu using p11_ui_run_10slot_list_submenu, gold check p11_ui_can_afford_gold, and tool award.

name: p11_ui_show_carpenter_upgrade_desc
summary: Clamps choice_idx to [0,4], closes active dialogue window, and opens window 2 with carpenter upgrade text from 0x8012d7a8.

name: p11_ui_init_carpenter_menu_ctx
summary: Initializes Gotz carpenter menu lists 0x8012d548 and 0x8012d5a8, wood/gold fields, and selects first unbuilt house upgrade.

name: p11_ui_run_woodcutter_shop_sm
summary: Runs Gotz woodcutter shop state machine handling lumber purchase (into g_ui_evt_add_fodder_count_consume_counter) and farmhouse/barn upgrade ordering with event flag 0x38.

name: p11_ui_find_first_unbuilt_house_upgrade
summary: Checks event flags 0x3a..0x3e via hm_event_flag_get and returns first unset upgrade index 0..4, or -1 if all built

name: p11_ui_run_shop_qty_999_picker
summary: Executes 6-state shop quantity picker up to 999 using 0x8011cf40, prompt 0x4d, and p11_ui_setup_menu_row_entry.

name: p11_ui_tick_shop_hud_state_machine

summary: Executes Memory Card read, write, or format confirmation for selected diary slot

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_init
summary: Save state 0: draws checking Memory Card dialog (0x80052fc4), resets FSM timers via hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry, and sets state to 1.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_probe_ports
summary: Save state 1: polls both Memory Card ports via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input into confirm_cursor[0..1], transitioning to state 2 (no card) or state 3 (select port).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_no_card
summary: Save state 2: displays no-Memory-Card dialog (0x80052ffa), waits for confirm via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(2, 0x16), and defaults cancel cursor_item to 1.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_select_port
summary: Save state 3: displays select-Memory-Card prompt (0x80053530) and calls ovl15_diary_prompt_memcard_port to pick active_port (state 4) or cancel to state 0x16.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_check_port
summary: Save state 4: polls selected active_port via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input and branches to state 5 (error), 6 (unformatted), 7 (scan slots), or 0x15 (card removed).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_card_error
summary: Save state 5: displays Memory Card error dialog (0x8005306a) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(5, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_card_retry_wait
summary: Save state 6: displays unformatted/check-card message (0x800530c8) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(6, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_scan_slots
summary: Save state 7: scans 3 save slots via ovl15_diary_read_slot_summary and ovl15_diary_check_memcard_space, records slot status codes in g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_count[0..2], and transitions to state 8.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_select_slot
summary: Save state 8: calls ovl15_diary_select_diary_slot(1) to select a save slot, branching by g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_count status to state 9 (overwrite), 10 (create), 0x11 (full), 0x12 (corrupt), or 0.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_confirm_overwrite
summary: Save state 9: draws all 3 diary slot cards (ovl15_diary_draw_slot_card(i, 1)) with overwrite prompt (0x8005313e) and ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no Yes/No, advancing to 0x13 (Yes) or 8 (No).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_check_create
summary: Save state 10: polls active_port via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input and dispatches through jump table g_ovl15_diary_save_state_create_jtbl_ptr for file creation or format confirmation.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_confirm_format
summary: Save state 0xb: executes two-step unformatted card prompt (notice via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance, then Yes/No via ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no), entering state 0xd (format) or 0 (cancel).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_format_card
summary: Save state 0xd: displays formatting notice (0x8005316c) and calls ovl15_diary_format_memcard(active_port), transitioning to state 0xf (ok), 0x15 (timeout), or 0xe (error).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_format_failed
summary: Save state 0xe: displays format-failed dialog (0x800531b8) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0xe, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_create_file
summary: Save state 0xf: displays creating-file dialog (0x8005346a) and calls ovl15_diary_create_save_file, branching to state 0x13 (ok), 0x11 (full), 0x15 (timeout), or 0x10 (error).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_write_failed
summary: Save state 0x10: displays save-failed dialog (0x80053506) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x10, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_card_full
summary: Save state 0x11: displays insufficient-blocks dialog (0x8005321a) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x11, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_corrupt_slot
summary: Save state 0x12: displays corrupt-slot dialog (0x80053294) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x12, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_payload
summary: Save state 0x13: builds slot summary/payload/checksums (ovl15_diary_build_save_slot_summary, ovl15_diary_serialize_save_payload, ovl15_diary_pack_save_blocks, ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums), writes PS1 SC icon header in g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value, sets state 0x14.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_write_card
summary: Save state 0x14: draws saving notice (0x8005346a) and polls ovl15_diary_write_save_file_async(active_port, menu_mode, &g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value), moving to 0x18 (ok), 0x10 (err), or 0x15 (removed).

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_card_removed
summary: Save state 0x15: displays Memory Card removed dialog (0x80052f4e) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x15, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_confirm_cancel
summary: Save state 0x16: displays cancel-save Yes/No prompt (g_ovl15_diary_save_state_confirm_value) via ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no, advancing to state 0x17 (exit) on Yes or state 0 on No/Cancel.

name: ovl15_diary_save_exit_cancel
summary: Calls hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry and sets g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_sub_state to 0xff to cancel and exit the Save/Create Diary flow.

name: ovl15_diary_save_state_complete
summary: Save state 0x18: displays save-complete message (0x800534dc), waits via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x18, 0) or timeout > 0x5a, then resets via hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry and sets sub_state = 1.

name: ovl15_diary_load_fsm_dispatch
summary: Entry wrapper for Load Diary FSM that passes g_ovl15_diary_save_blob.state into ovl15_diary_load_fsm_step for cases 0..0x13 and card removal polling.

name: ovl15_diary_load_fsm_step
summary: Switch-table body for Load Diary FSM (state_id 0..0x13) dispatching Load state handlers and polling ovl15_diary_poll_memcard_status to catch Memory Card removal.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_init
summary: Load state 0: draws checking Memory Card dialog (0x80052fc4), resets FSM timers via hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry, and sets state to 1.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_probe_ports
summary: Load state 1: polls both Memory Card ports via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input into confirm_cursor[0..1], transitioning to state 2 (no card) or state 3 (select port).

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_no_card
summary: Load state 2: displays no-Memory-Card dialog (0x80052ffa), waits for confirm via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(2, 0x11), and defaults cancel cursor_item to 1.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_select_port
summary: Load state 3: displays select-Memory-Card prompt (0x80053530) and calls ovl15_diary_prompt_memcard_port to pick active_port (state 4) or cancel to state 0x11.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_check_port
summary: Load state 4: polls selected active_port via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input and dispatches through jump table g_ovl15_diary_state_port_jtbl_ptr (defaulting to state 7 slot scan).

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_card_error
summary: Load state 5: displays Memory Card error dialog (0x8005306a) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(5, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_card_retry_wait
summary: Load state 6: displays unformatted/check-card message (0x800530c8) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(6, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_scan_slots
summary: Load state 7: scans 3 save slots via ovl15_diary_read_slot_summary and ovl15_diary_check_memcard_space, entering state 9 if any valid save exists in g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_count..24 or state 8 (no save data).

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_no_saves
summary: Load state 8: displays no-save-data message (0x800532fe) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(8, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_select_slot
summary: Load state 9: calls ovl15_diary_select_diary_slot(0) to choose a diary slot to load, branching to state 0xb if slot status == 0, state 10 if invalid, or state 0 on back.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_invalid_slot
summary: Load state 10: displays empty/unusable-slot message (0x800523ac) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(10, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_prep_read
summary: Load state 0xb: displays loading dialog (0x80053350), formats filename into g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_prep_value via ovl15_diary_get_save_filename(menu_mode), and sets state to 0xc.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_read_card
summary: Load state 0xc: displays loading dialog (0x80053350) and polls ovl15_diary_read_save_file_async(active_port, menu_mode, &g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value), moving to 0xd (ok), 0xf (err), or 0x10 (removed).

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_verify_data
summary: Load state 0xd: checks loaded save checksums via ovl15_diary_verify_save_checksums and sentinel g_ovl15_diary_save_slots_idx0_farmer_name_idx8[menu_mode]==0x14, advancing to state 0x13 (valid) or state 0xe (corrupt).

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_corrupt_data
summary: Load state 0xe: displays corrupt-save-data message (0x8005341e) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0xe, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_read_failed
summary: Load state 0xf: displays load-failed dialog (0x800533f6) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0xf, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_card_removed
summary: Load state 0x10: displays Memory Card removed dialog (0x80052f4e) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x10, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_confirm_cancel
summary: Load state 0x11: displays cancel-load Yes/No prompt (0x80051e02) via ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no, setting state 0x12 (exit) on Yes or state 0 on No/Cancel.

name: ovl15_diary_load_exit_cancel
summary: Calls hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry and sets g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_sub_state to 0xff to cancel and exit the Load Diary flow.

name: ovl15_diary_load_state_apply_and_finish
summary: Load state 0x13: displays load-complete (0x800533c8), waits via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x13, 0) or timeout > 0x5a, then unpacks/deserializes save (ovl15_diary_unpack_save_blocks/ovl15_diary_deserialize_save_payload) and sets sub_state = 1.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_fsm_dispatch
summary: Entry wrapper for Animal Trade FSM that passes g_ovl15_diary_save_blob.state into ovl15_diary_trade_fsm_step for cases 0..0x21 and card removal polling.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_fsm_step
summary: Switch-table body for Animal Trade FSM (state_id 0..0x21) dispatching Trade state handlers and polling ovl15_diary_poll_memcard_status to catch Memory Card removal.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_init
summary: Trade state 0: draws checking Memory Card dialog (0x80052fc4), resets FSM timers via hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry, clears trade buffers via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_state, and sets state to 1.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_probe_ports
summary: Trade state 1: polls both Memory Card ports via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input into confirm_cursor[0..1], transitioning to state 2 (no card) or state 3 (select port).

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_no_card
summary: Trade state 2: displays no-Memory-Card dialog (0x80052ffa), waits for confirm via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(2, 0x1f), and defaults cancel cursor_item to 1.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_select_port
summary: Trade state 3: displays select-Memory-Card prompt (0x80053530) and calls ovl15_diary_prompt_memcard_port to pick active_port (state 4) or cancel to state 0x1f.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_check_port
summary: Trade state 4: polls selected active_port via hm_ovl15_name_entry_input and branches to state 5 (error), 6 (unformatted), 7 (scan slots), or 0x1e (card removed).

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_card_error
summary: Trade state 5: displays Memory Card error dialog (0x8005306a) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(5, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_card_retry_wait
summary: Trade state 6: displays unformatted/check-card message (0x800530c8) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(6, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_scan_slots
summary: Trade state 7: scans 3 save slots via ovl15_diary_read_slot_summary and ovl15_diary_check_memcard_space, entering state 9 if any valid save exists in g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_count..24 or state 8 (no save data).

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_no_saves
summary: Trade state 8: displays no-save-data message (0x800532fe) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(8, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_select_slot
summary: Trade state 9: calls ovl15_diary_select_diary_slot(0) to choose a remote diary slot, branching to state 0xb if slot status == 0, state 10 if invalid, or state 0 on back.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_invalid_slot
summary: Trade state 10: displays empty/unusable-slot message (0x800523ac) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(10, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_prep_read
summary: Trade state 0xb: displays loading dialog (0x80053350), formats remote save filename into g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_prep_value via ovl15_diary_get_save_filename(menu_mode), and sets state to 0xc.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_read_card
summary: Trade state 0xc: displays loading dialog (0x80053350) and polls ovl15_diary_read_save_file_async(active_port, menu_mode, &g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value), moving to 0xd (ok), 0xf (err), or 0x1e (removed).

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_verify_and_unpack
summary: Trade state 0xd: checks remote save checksums via ovl15_diary_verify_save_checksums and sentinel 0x14; if valid, unpacks via ovl15_diary_unpack_save_blocks and enters state 0x10, else state 0xe.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_corrupt_data
summary: Trade state 0xe: displays corrupt-save-data message (0x8005341e) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0xe, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_read_failed
summary: Trade state 0xf: displays load-failed dialog (0x800533f6) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0xf, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_card_removed
summary: Trade state 0x1e: displays Memory Card removed dialog (0x80052f4e) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x1e, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_check_distinct_farm
summary: Trade state 0x10: compares 8-byte farm ID at save_buf_ptr+0x225c against local g_ovl15_field_all_animal_pickup_evt_state via bcmp, rejecting identical farm (state 0x11) or resetting trade via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_state to 0x12.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_same_farm_error
summary: Trade state 0x11: displays cannot-trade-same-farm error (0x8005204a) and returns to slot select state 9 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x11, 9) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_pick_local_animals
summary: Trade state 0x12: runs ovl15_diary_run_trade_picker_screen(0) to pick outgoing local animals, advancing to state 0x13 on confirm (1) or resetting via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf to state 9 on cancel (-1).

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_pick_remote_animals
summary: Trade state 0x13: runs ovl15_diary_run_trade_picker_screen(1) to pick incoming remote animals, advancing to state 0x14 on confirm (1) or resetting via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf to state 0x12 on cancel (-1).

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_validate_capacity
summary: Trade state 0x14: tallies selected animals in g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_trade_table and farm totals via ovl15_diary_count_animals_with_pregnant against coop (5/10) and barn (10/20) limits, branching to error 0x15..0x19 or 0x1a.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_err_none_selected
summary: Trade state 0x15: displays no-animals-selected message (0x80052150), returns to local picker state 0x12 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x15, 0x12), and resets work buf via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_err_local_coop_full
summary: Trade state 0x16: displays local-coop-full error (0x80052178), returns to local picker state 0x12 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x16, 0x12), and resets work buf via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_err_remote_coop_full
summary: Trade state 0x17: displays remote-coop-full error (0x800521f6), returns to local picker state 0x12 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x17, 0x12), and resets work buf via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_err_local_barn_full
summary: Trade state 0x18: displays local-barn-full error (0x80052280), returns to local picker state 0x12 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x18, 0x12), and resets work buf via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_err_remote_barn_full
summary: Trade state 0x19: displays remote-barn-full error (0x8005230a), returns to local picker state 0x12 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x19, 0x12), and resets work buf via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_confirm_summary
summary: Trade state 0x1a: draws trade summary boxes (ovl15_diary_draw_trade_summary_boxes) and confirm Yes/No prompt (ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no), entering state 0x1b on Yes or resetting via ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf to 0x13.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_confirm_write
summary: Trade state 0x1b: draws target slot card (ovl15_diary_draw_slot_card) and overwrite Yes/No (ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no); on Yes runs ovl15_diary_commit_local_to_remote_trade/ovl15_diary_pack_save_blocks/ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums -> 0x1d, else ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf -> 0x1a.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_write_card
summary: Trade state 0x1d: writes updated remote save via ovl15_diary_write_save_file_async, calling ovl15_diary_commit_remote_to_local_trade on completion to transfer incoming animals to local farm (state 0x21) or error 0x1c/0x1e.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_write_failed
summary: Trade state 0x1c: displays save-failed dialog (0x80053506) and resets to state 0 via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x1c, 0) or after card_busy > 0x5a frames.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_confirm_cancel
summary: Trade state 0x1f: displays quit-trade Yes/No prompt (0x80051e88) via ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no, setting state 0x20 (exit) on Yes or state 0 on No/Cancel.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_exit_cancel
summary: Calls hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry and sets g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_sub_state to 0xff to cancel and exit the Animal Trade flow.

name: ovl15_diary_trade_state_complete
summary: Trade state 0x21: displays trade-complete message (0x80052022), waits via ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance(0x21, 0) or timeout > 0x5a, then resets via hm_ovl15_memcard_ui_entry and sets sub_state = 1.

name: ovl15_diary_place_coop_bird_in_stall
summary: Sets coop chicken position (+0x38..+0x40) from table g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_idx15 with (coop_slot % 5) * 400 X offset, random facing via hm_prng_next(4), and state 4 (+0x30).

name: ovl15_diary_place_barn_animal_in_stall
summary: Sets barn animal world coordinates (+0x38..+0x40) from stall table g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_idx23 (or special slots -1/-2), facing direction (+0x22), and state 5 (+0x30).

name: ovl15_diary_commit_local_to_remote_trade
summary: Stages selected remote farm animals from g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_save_buf_ptr into g_ovl15_diary_commit_local_remote_trade_value, clears remote slots, and moves selected local animals into free remote slots via ovl15_diary_find_free_animal_slot.

name: ovl15_diary_commit_remote_to_local_trade
summary: Moves staged remote animals from g_ovl15_diary_commit_remote_local_value_2/g_ovl15_diary_commit_local_remote_trade_value into free local coop (g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl) or barn (g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl) slots via ovl15_diary_find_free_animal_slot and places them in stalls.

name: ovl15_diary_find_free_animal_slot
summary: Scans 10 coop slots (stride 0xB4) or 20 barn slots at +0x708 (stride 0xB8) for an empty entry, writes slot index to *out_slot_idx, and returns slot pointer.

name: ovl15_diary_count_animals_with_pregnant
summary: Counts active coop chickens (10 slots) or barn livestock (20 slots at +0x708, adding +1 extra per pregnant animal) for animal trade capacity checks.

name: ovl15_diary_draw_trade_summary_boxes
summary: Draws side-by-side local and remote trade summary windows (evt_res_draw_dialog_frame, hm_text_draw_dialog_line) and lists selected outgoing/incoming animals via ovl15_diary_draw_animal_icon_and_hearts.

name: ovl15_diary_run_trade_picker_screen
summary: Draws trade species tabs and owner name (g_ui_snapshot_status_summary_animal_diary_cfg or save_buf_ptr+0x2378), switches chicken/cow/sheep tab g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_off_2, and tail-calls ovl15_diary_run_trade_animal_list returning picker result.

name: ovl15_diary_run_trade_animal_list
summary: Runs scrollable animal trade selection list (g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_idx1/g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_off_6) drawing up to 4 rows via ovl15_diary_draw_trade_animal_row and toggling up to 5 picks via ovl15_diary_add_trade_selection/ovl15_diary_remove_trade_selection.

name: ovl15_diary_add_trade_selection
summary: Appends (species_tab g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_off_2, animal_slot) to the 5-slot local or remote trade selection list in g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_trade_table and increments g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_idx2.

name: ovl15_diary_remove_trade_selection
summary: Clears a matching (species_tab g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_off_2, animal_slot) entry in the 5-slot trade selection table at g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_trade_table to 0xffff and decrements g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_idx2.

name: ovl15_diary_is_animal_selected_for_trade
summary: Scans the 5-slot trade selection table at g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_trade_table (local if &g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl, else remote) for (g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_off_2, animal_slot), returning 1 if found or 0.

name: ovl15_diary_draw_animal_icon_and_hearts
summary: Submits animal sprite (0x109..0x166) via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad, draws name text via hm_text_draw_dialog_line, and draws affection/25 hearts via ovl15_diary_draw_affection_hearts.

name: ovl15_diary_draw_trade_animal_row
summary: Renders an animal picker row at y using ovl15_diary_draw_animal_icon_and_hearts, pregnancy/product text (hm_text_fetch_script_entry), age/size field (ovl15_diary_read_s16_value), and contest crown icon (evt_res_draw_glyph_sprite).

name: ovl15_diary_read_s16_value
summary: Dereferences and sign-extends a 16-bit signed field from *value_ptr (used for reading animal age/size index in ovl15_diary_draw_trade_animal_row).

name: ovl15_diary_draw_affection_hearts
summary: Draws heart_count affection hearts stepping x by -8 pixels per icon using evt_res_draw_icon_space.

name: ovl15_diary_find_tradeable_animal
summary: Filters eligible non-pregnant chickens (tab 0), cows (tab 1), or sheep (tab 2); returns filtered count when target_ordinal is -1, else returns raw slot index.

name: ovl15_diary_reset_trade_state
summary: Calls ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf, clears both 5-slot local and remote trade selection arrays at g_ovl15_diary_save_state_prepare_trade_table to 0xffff, and zeroes 0x398 bytes at g_ovl15_diary_commit_local_remote_trade_value.

name: ovl15_diary_reset_trade_work_buf
summary: Resets trade picker cursor/selection globals g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_off_2..g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_slot_and_card_work_idx2 to 0 and zeroes the 0x1568-byte trade scratch buffer via memset.

name: ovl15_diary_build_memcard_sjis_title
summary: Builds the 40-byte Shift-JIS Memory Card directory title at g_ovl15_diary_build_memcard_sjis_value_3 from diary number, year (g_ovl15_diary_save_slots), and season (g_ovl15_diary_save_slots_idx0_year) via ovl15_diary_format_sjis_number/ovl15_diary_append_sjis_season_name.

name: ovl15_diary_format_sjis_number
summary: Formats a 1- or 2-digit integer into Shift-JIS full-width numerals and appends them into out_str using digit templates g_ovl15_diary_build_memcard_sjis_format_value/g_ovl15_diary_format_sjis_number_value and strcat.

name: ovl15_diary_append_sjis_season_name
summary: Clamps season_idx to [0, 3] and appends the Shift-JIS season name from g_ovl15_season_name_sjis_dat_ptr into out_str via strcat.

name: ovl15_diary_build_save_slot_summary
summary: Populates HmSaveSlotSummary at g_ovl15_diary_save_slots[slot_idx] from calendar/player/overlay globals, clears 0x9690 bytes at g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value, and copies summary to g_ovl15_diary_build_save_slot_compute_value.

name: ovl15_diary_serialize_save_payload
summary: Packs live game state (coop g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl, minigame, calendar, HmPlayerState, field/greenhouse grids, barn/NPCs, and 36 actor summaries) into g_ovl15_memcard_diary_deserialize_value.

name: ovl15_diary_deserialize_save_payload
summary: Restores serialized save payload from g_ovl15_memcard_diary_deserialize_value back into live game globals (coop, engine flags, minigame, calendar, player, grids, barn/NPCs, and weather).

name: ovl15_diary_pack_save_blocks
summary: Expands 201 127-byte save payload blocks at g_ovl15_memcard_diary_deserialize_value into 128-byte strides via memmove for checksum insertion and seeds salt g_ovl15_diary_pack_save_blocks_count via hm_prng_next(0x100).

name: ovl15_diary_unpack_save_blocks
summary: Compacts 201 128-byte save payload blocks at g_ovl15_memcard_diary_deserialize_value into contiguous 127-byte strides (0x7f from 0x80) via memmove, stripping per-block parity bytes.

name: ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums
summary: Computes per-block XOR parity bytes across 251 save blocks (g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value+0x280), storing combined block parity in g_ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums_verify_state and header parity in g_ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums_verify_flag.

name: ovl15_diary_verify_save_checksums
summary: Verifies XOR parity across all 251 save blocks, combined parity g_ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums_verify_state, and header summary parity g_ovl15_diary_compute_save_checksums_verify_flag, returning 0 if valid or -1 on mismatch.

name: hm_ovl15_name_entry_input
summary: Handles kana/alphabet character grid cursor selection for farmer, dog, or horse naming

name: ovl15_diary_poll_memcard_status
summary: Polls Memory Card presence and async command completion on port 0/1 (chan 0x00/0x10) via MemCardSync and MemCardExist, returning status code 0/3/4/5/8/0xc.

name: ovl15_diary_check_memcard_space
summary: Queries MemCardGetDirentry for BASLUS-01115-FARM%d existence and free block count (requiring 4 blocks or 10 when slot_idx==3), returning 0, 0xb (full), 0xf, or error.

name: ovl15_diary_read_slot_summary
summary: Reads the 128-byte header block at offset 0x200 from BASLUS-01115-FARM%d via MemCardReadFile, copies HmSaveSlotSummary to out_summary, and checks XOR parity (0xe on error).

name: ovl15_diary_format_memcard
summary: Formats the Memory Card in port 0/1 (chan 0x00/0x10) via MemCardSync and MemCardFormat with timeout retries (g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_prompt_id), returning 0 on success or 2/4/0xc.

name: ovl15_diary_create_save_file
summary: Creates a 4-block BASLUS-01115-FARM%d file on Memory Card port 0/1 via MemCardCreateFile with retry counter g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_prompt_id, returning 0 or status 2/4/0xb/0xc.

name: ovl15_diary_write_save_file_async
summary: Polls MemCardSync (cmd 4) or starts async 0x8000-byte MemCardWriteFile from save_buf to BASLUS-01115-FARM%d, returning 3 while busy, 0 when done, or error.

name: ovl15_diary_read_save_file_async
summary: Polls MemCardSync (cmd 3) or starts async 0x8000-byte MemCardReadFile from BASLUS-01115-FARM%d into save_buf, returning 3 while busy, 0 when done, or error.

name: ovl15_diary_prompt_memcard_port
summary: Renders Memory Card Slot 1/2 chooser window (evt_res_draw_dialog_frame, hm_text_draw_dialog_line, evt_res_draw_cursor_hand), handles up/down cursor g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_card_flag, returning 0/1, -1 cancel, or 2 pending.

name: ovl15_diary_select_diary_slot
summary: Draws 3 diary slot cards (ovl15_diary_draw_slot_card), moves cursor g_ovl15_diary_save_blob_card_flag (0..2) on up/down pad input with SFX, returning selected slot 0..2, -1 cancel, or 3 pending.

name: ovl15_diary_draw_slot_card
summary: Draws diary slot card slot_idx via evt_res_draw_dialog_frame/hm_res_ui_bind_font_slot/hm_text_draw_dialog_line, displaying slot status (empty/corrupt/unusable) or farmer, year, and season from g_ovl15_diary_save_slots.

name: ovl15_diary_format_slot_field_text
summary: Maps field_idx (1/2/3/other -> offset 0x12/0x18/0x1e/0x24 in g_ui_shop_tv_menu_seasonal_portrait_table), fetches localized script text via hm_text_fetch_script_entry, and converts via hm_res_ui_draw_icon_row.

name: ovl15_diary_prompt_yes_no
summary: Draws Yes/No prompt box (g_ovl15_yes_no_prompt_box_region) with cursor g_ovl15_diary_cursor_item via evt_res_draw_cursor_hand, handles confirm/cancel pad input with SFX, returning 0 (Yes), 1 (No), -1, or 2 pending.

name: ovl15_diary_wait_confirm_advance
summary: Draws blinking prompt advance arrow via hm_res_ui_draw_prompt_arrow at (0x11d, 0xd9) and returns next_state with confirm SFX (hm_audio_play_sfx(0)) on pad edge, else cur_state.

name: ovl15_diary_init_resources
summary: Calls init hooks (0x801372f0, 0x801372f8, 0x80137398), loads archive part 0x10 via ovl15_diary_load_overlay_font_or_data, and loads trade sprites via ovl15_diary_load_animal_trade_sprites when load_trade_gfx != 0.

name: ovl15_diary_init_stub_a
summary: Empty initialization hook called first by ovl15_diary_init_resources before loading overlay font/resource archives.

name: ovl15_diary_init_stub_b
summary: Empty initialization hook called second by ovl15_diary_init_resources before loading overlay font/resource archives.

name: ovl15_diary_load_overlay_font_or_data
summary: Calls DrawSync(0) and ClearOTagR on active OT, then synchronously loads archive part 0x10 (0x900 bytes) into g_ovl15_memcard_diary_overlay_cfg via hm_afile_read_or_load_overlay.

name: ovl15_diary_init_stub_c
summary: Empty initialization hook called by ovl15_diary_init_resources after loading archive part 0x10 and before optional trade sprite loading.

name: ovl15_diary_load_animal_trade_sprites
summary: Streams archive part 0x0e (0x8e90 bytes) to g_ovl15_memcard_diary_save_value, unpacks VRAM via hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_pack_auto, copies sprite pack to g_ovl15_diary_animal_trade_sprites_value_1, and inits 5 sprite anim slots.

name: ovl15_diary_get_save_filename
summary: Copies PS1 Memory Card save filename BASLUS-01115-FARM0..3 (clamping slot_idx > 3 to 0) into out_name via strcpy.

name: hm_ovl17_swim_race_entry
summary: Summer Swimming Festival 6-racer minigame overlay entrypoint

name: hm_ovl17_swim_race_init
summary: Loads swimming beach sprites/VAB audio and initializes 6 swimmer lanes

name: ovl17_run_intro_fade_in
summary: Renders pool and treading swimmers while waiting for fade-in completion before advancing g_core_minigame_state.

name: ovl17_dispatch_festival_substate
summary: Clears per-frame dialogue UI, dispatches g_ovl17_festival_state handler in g_ovl17_dispatch_festival_substate_fn_ptr, and calls hm_ovl17_swim_race_award(1).

name: ovl17_fade_in_festival_phase
summary: Starts screen/audio fade-in via sys_init_display_timing(10) and hm_res_spu_set_bgm_vol(10) and advances g_core_minigame_state.

name: ovl17_run_exit_transition
summary: Draws pool backdrop, waits for screen/audio fadeout, awards +20/+500 villager affection if won, and exits to overlay 6.

name: ovl17_state_init_lineup
summary: Renders initial pool and treading swimmers, invokes ovl17_setup_race_participants, and transitions g_ovl17_festival_state to 1.

name: ovl17_setup_race_participants
summary: Resets swimmer lanes, maps participant IDs g_ovl11_ovl_betting_racer_row_setup_count to name offsets g_ovl17_setup_race_participants_table, and clears wake trail.

name: ovl17_state_ready_prompt
summary: Binds all 6 swimmer names into dialogue tokens, displays dialogue (4, 3), and transitions g_ovl17_festival_state to 6.

name: ovl17_state_intro_breath_demo
summary: Cycles player breath gauge g_ovl17_state_intro_breath_demo_gauge_counter every 30 frames during intro dialogue (4, 0), advancing g_ovl17_festival_state to 3.

name: ovl17_state_ask_rules_or_retry
summary: Draws swimmers and prompts rules dialogue (4, 1), branching g_ovl17_festival_state to 4 or resetting lanes to state 2.

name: ovl17_state_explain_rules
summary: Draws pool and swimmers while running rules dialogue (4, 2), then resets lanes and advances g_ovl17_festival_state to 5.

name: ovl17_state_pre_race_lineup
summary: Binds swimmer names, renders treading swimmers and pool, runs dialogue (4, 4), and advances g_ovl17_festival_state to 6.

name: ovl17_state_start_countdown
summary: Runs start countdown dialogue (4, 5) for 60 frames, initializes swimmer base speeds, plays SFX 0x38, and sets state 7.

name: hm_ovl17_swim_race_loop
summary: Main Swimming Festival loop polling stroke/breath stamina and rendering 6 swimmers

name: ovl17_run_race_finish_announce
summary: Draws pool/wakes, populates ranked swimmer names into dialogue tokens, runs dialogue (4, 6), and sets state 9.

name: ovl17_state_player_won_payout
summary: Displays odds board with payout, runs win dialogue (4, 7), plays win fanfare SFX 0x3e, and sets g_ovl17_festival_state to 10.

name: ovl17_state_player_lost_payout
summary: Displays odds board, writes medal reward to g_ovl17_state_player_lost_payout_value (g_ovl17_exit_transition_state=0), runs dialogue (4, 8), and exits phase.

name: ovl17_init_wake_trail_ring
summary: Initializes 90 wake particle slots in g_ovl17_setup_race_participants_state_swim_state/g_ovl17_push_wake_trail_particle_particles_value_2 and sets g_ovl17_wake_trail_ring_push_state cursor to 6.

name: ovl17_push_wake_trail_particle
summary: Records wake splash world_x and screen_y into the 90-slot ring buffer at g_ovl17_push_wake_trail_particle_particles_value_1/g_ovl17_push_wake_trail_particle_particles_value_2.

name: ovl17_draw_wake_trail_particles
summary: Submits 0x0e quad sprites (g_ovl17_wake_trail_particles_festival_pool_value) for all active wake particles in g_ovl17_push_wake_trail_particle_particles_value_1/g_ovl17_push_wake_trail_particle_particles_value_2.

name: ovl17_render_active_race_frame
summary: Draws water backdrop, all 6 racing swimmers via ovl17_draw_swimmer_racing, and pool/crowd at camera X g_ovl17_swim_race_wake_render_state.

name: ovl17_update_ai_swimmer_inputs
summary: Evaluates pace tier, speed (>80), and breath thresholds to roll AI stroke triggers into g_ovl17_ai_swimmer_inputs_apply_value.

name: ovl17_apply_swimmer_strokes
summary: Deducts breath g_ovl17_apply_swimmer_strokes_festival_counter_2 and boosts speed (+0x2e) for stroking swimmers, with 34% chance of splash SFX 0x3d.

name: ovl17_decay_swimmer_speeds
summary: Decays each of the 6 swimmers' current speed toward base speed using breath and drag divisor g_ovl17_decay_swimmer_speeds_festival_counter.

name: ovl17_update_race_rankings
summary: Appends swimmers passing finish X 0x800000 to finish order g_ovl17_swim_race_finish_rankings_state or selects leading swimmer.

name: ovl17_update_camera_target_speed
summary: Adjusts camera tracking speed g_ovl17_swim_race_camera_festival_counter relative to leading swimmer X and camera scroll g_ovl17_swim_race_wake_render_state.

name: ovl17_step_finish_check
summary: Stands up leader past 0x800000, clamps all 6 swimmers at 0x940000, and returns true when all finish.

name: ovl17_draw_odds_board_and_payout
summary: Draws the 6-swimmer odds/payout table from g_ovl11_ovl_betting_racer_row_all_table/g_ui_festival_bet_pool_empty_open_table and returns computed bet payout.

name: ovl17_calc_swimmer_base_speed
summary: Computes swimmer minimum base speed from g_ovl17_swimmer_base_speed_festival_counter_globals, g_ovl17_swimmer_base_speed_festival_count, g_ovl17_swimmer_base_speed_festival_counter_1, and lane_skill.

name: ovl17_recover_all_swimmer_breath
summary: Increments breath gauge (+0x2a) by 5 per frame for all 6 swimmers in g_ovl17_setup_race_participants_state_swim_state up to 0xff.

name: ovl17_get_ai_pace_tier
summary: Computes AI swimmer pace tier (0..2) from leader distance g_ovl17_ai_pace_tier_festival_count, stats g_ovl17_ai_pace_tier_count/g_ovl17_ai_pace_tier_value, and nearby rivals.

name: ovl17_eval_ai_catchup_stat
summary: Evaluates AI catch-up probability when trailing the leader by calling ovl17_roll_ai_stat_check(stat_val + 1).

name: ovl17_eval_ai_lead_stat
summary: Evaluates AI pace-conservation check when ahead by calling ovl17_roll_ai_stat_check(0x7f - stat_val).

name: ovl17_eval_ai_rival_stat
summary: Evaluates AI rival-sprint probability by calling ovl17_roll_ai_stat_check(stat_val + 1).

name: ovl17_roll_ai_stat_check
summary: Rolls hm_prng_next(100) against scaled stat_val threshold ((stat_val * 100) / 0x7f).

name: ovl17_has_swimmer_nearby_ahead
summary: Checks whether any rival swimmer in g_ovl17_swim_race_rankings_camera_value is ahead of swimmer_idx within 0x59fff fixed-point units.

name: ovl17_is_breath_above_threshold
summary: Returns whether swimmer_idx's breath field g_ovl17_festival_ctx_off_2 exceeds the given threshold.

name: ovl17_is_speed_above_80
summary: Returns whether swimmer_idx's current speed g_ovl17_speed_above_count exceeds 0x50.

name: ovl17_roll_ai_stroke_chance
summary: Rolls hm_prng_next(0x7f) and returns true when the random roll exceeds threshold.

name: ovl17_load_swimmer_sprites_a
summary: Loads A_FILE part 0 (0x25000..0x2a800) into high-RAM arena, unpacks VRAM, and initializes g_ovl17_swimmer_sprites_value_2.

name: ovl17_load_beach_hud_vram
summary: Syncs GPU, clears OT, reads 0x2000 bytes from A_FILE part 0, and unpacks VRAM textures via hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_pack_auto.

name: ovl17_load_festival_pack_and_anims
summary: Loads A_FILE part 0x12 (0x1e0a8 bytes), unpacks VRAM pack, and initializes all 6 swimmer and UI 0x0e anims.

name: ovl17_init_festival_audio
summary: Frees VAB/SEQ banks 1 and 2, stops active BGM (999), and plays Swim Festival BGM sequence 0x15.

name: ovl17_reset_festival_globals
summary: Initializes Swim Festival tuning constants in g_ovl17_setup_race_participants_state_swim_state, clears rankings, unpacks AI table, and resets swimmer lanes.

name: ovl17_unpack_ai_chance_table
summary: Unpacks 3x6 byte AI stroke probability entries from g_ovl17_unpack_ai_chance_table into u16 slots at g_ovl17_ai_swimmer_inputs_unpack_table.

name: ovl17_init_lane_render_coords
summary: Populates the 6 lane screen-Y positions (0x4d + i*0x1a) and OT/palette indices at g_ovl17_setup_race_participants_lane_swimmer_count.

name: ovl17_reset_swimmer_lanes
summary: Resets all 6 swimmer blocks in g_ovl17_setup_race_participants_state_swim_state with stats from g_ovl17_swimmer_lanes_evt_count/g_ovl17_swimmer_lanes_count and start X -0x20000.

name: ovl17_draw_pool_and_crowd
summary: Renders scrolling pool water tiles, lane ropes, start/finish walls, and beach spectators (g_ovl17_pool_crowd_value_1) relative to cam_x.

name: ovl17_draw_swimmer_idle_or_splash
summary: Advances and renders a swimmer with shadow, player breath icon g_ovl17_festival_pack_anims_swimmer_racing_value, and periodic wake particle emission.

name: ovl17_draw_swimmer_racing
summary: Renders a racing swimmer's 0x0e animation frame, drop shadow, and player breath gauge indicator relative to cam_x.

name: ovl17_update_breath_gauge_sprite
summary: Selects breath indicator anim state (1 or 2) from player breath g_ovl17_state_intro_breath_demo_gauge_counter and updates g_ovl17_festival_pack_anims_swimmer_racing_value.

name: ovl17_draw_water_backdrop
summary: Sets g_ovl17_wake_trail_particles_festival_pool_value to anim frame 4 and submits the background water quad to the active display OT.

name: ovl17_set_swimmer_tread_anim
summary: Transitions swimmer_ptr's 0x0e sprite descriptor (+0x20) to anim state 2 (treading water) via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: ovl17_set_all_swimmers_tread
summary: Loops over all 6 swimmers in g_ovl17_festival_ctx (stride 0x50) and sets each to treading-water state 2.

name: ovl17_set_swimmer_swim_anim
summary: Transitions swimmer_ptr's 0x0e sprite descriptor (+0x20) to anim state 0 (swimming) via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: ovl17_set_all_swimmers_swim
summary: Loops over all 6 swimmers in g_ovl17_festival_ctx (stride 0x50) and sets each to active swimming state 0.

name: ovl17_set_swimmer_stand_anim
summary: Transitions swimmer_ptr's 0x0e sprite descriptor (+0x20) to anim state 1 (standing) via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: hm_ovl17_swim_race_award
summary: Awards Swimming Festival Power Berry/medals and settles race outcome

name: ovl17_add_villager_affection_20
summary: Adds 20 (clamped at 0xff) to villager affection field g_npc_trigger_cutscene_script_actor_ovl_table for npc_idx.

name: ovl17_add_villager_affection_500
summary: Adds 500 (clamped at 0xffff) to villager affection word g_npc_actor0_affection for npc_idx.

name: hm_ovl19_chicken_sumo_entry
summary: Chicken Sumo Festival 2-actor + 3-spectator arena minigame entrypoint

name: hm_ovl19_chicken_sumo_init
summary: Loads ring textures, fighter chicken stats, and 3 spectator sprite descriptors

name: ovl19_run_bracket_intro
summary: Updates 3D arena stage, draws tournament bracket UI, and waits for fade-in completion before advancing minigame state.

name: ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase
summary: Clears per-frame dialogue UI, updates 3D camera/GTE stage model, and dispatches g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter in g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_fn_ptr.

name: ovl19_phase_fade_in_arena
summary: Starts screen/audio fade-in (10), renders all arena actors, and advances g_core_minigame_state.

name: ovl19_phase_exit_festival
summary: Renders arena, waits for fadeout, frees VAB/SEQ, exits to overlay 6, and awards +20 affection to 12 villagers on win.

name: ovl19_init_tournament_bracket
summary: Shuffles 8 unique chicken IDs (0..19) into g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_phase_value, resets bout actors, and initializes AI tuning parameters.

name: ovl19_reset_bout_actors
summary: Clears winner/audio handles (g_ovl19_bout_actors_chicken_phase_counter, g_ovl19_phase_exit_festival_bout_chicken_counter, g_ovl19_bout_actors_chicken_phase_state) and resets both fighters and 3 spectators.

name: ovl19_reset_fighter_positions
summary: Resets both fighter structs from g_ovl19_fighter_positions_value_2, rolls opponent strength g_ovl19_fighter_positions_cpu_resolve_counter, and sets color g_ovl19_fighter_positions_count.

name: ovl19_init_spectators_and_crowd
summary: Initializes 3 spectator chicken records at g_ovl19_phase_announce_match_ready_chicken_table from g_ovl19_spectators_crowd_value and sets g_ovl19_spectators_crowd_count by round g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighter_spectators_counter.

name: ovl19_roll_opponent_affection
summary: Rolls CPU chicken opponent affection/strength for round g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighter_spectators_counter from g_ovl19_roll_opponent_affection_table (+0xab in round 2).

name: ovl19_phase_show_bracket
summary: Renders arena actors and tournament bracket UI, advancing g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to phase 1 on confirm button press (0x60).

name: ovl19_phase_round_prompt
summary: Displays round prompt dialogue (4, 0xf/0x10) for round 1/2 and branches g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to phase 3 or 2.

name: ovl19_phase_run_bout
summary: Dispatches bout substate g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_phase_bout_counter in g_ovl19_phase_bout_fn_ptr, steps fighters, and renders actors until substate 7 exits.

name: ovl19_phase_announce_match
summary: Resets bout actors, shows round intro dialogue (g_ovl19_phase_announce_match_calendar_table[round]) for 60 frames, and advances g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to 4.

name: ovl19_phase_ready_set
summary: Renders arena and shows pre-fight ready prompt (4, 0x12) for 45 frames before advancing g_ovl19_dispatch_festival_phase_tournament_show_counter to 5.

name: hm_ovl19_chicken_sumo_loop
summary: Runs Chicken Sumo ring physics, crow/scare button timing, and ring-out checks

name: ovl19_phase_post_bout_result
summary: Announces bout win (4, 0x16) or loss (4, 0x17) with winner name, increments round g_ovl19_tournament_bracket_fighter_spectators_counter, or advances to champion.

name: ovl19_phase_champion_award
summary: Renders arena actors, sets tournament victory flag g_ovl19_phase_exit_festival_post_champion_state = 1, and advances g_core_minigame_state.

name: ovl19_bout_state_spawn_entrance
summary: Resets bout actors, places fighters at ring edges (x=0xbe/-0xbe, z=-100), sets initial stances, and sets substate 1.

name: ovl19_bout_state_enter_ring

name: ovl23_update_all_dogs

name: ovl23_push_trainer_trail_mark

name: ovl23_steer_dog_with_avoidance

name: hm_ovl23_dog_race_hud_bar

name: ovl23_atan2_degrees

name: ovl23_pick_trainer_speed_tier

name: ovl23_step_trainer_pos

name: ovl23_dispatch_dog_anim

name: ovl23_draw_trainer_sprite

name: ovl23_draw_scrolling_track

name: ovl23_world_x_to_screen_x

name: ovl23_set_dog_motion

name: ovl23_set_trainer_motion

name: ovl23_pause_racer_sprites

name: ovl23_resume_racer_sprites

name: ovl23_draw_pause_banner
summary: Sets g_ovl23_trail_marks_scrolling_pause_value anim sequence 5 and submits the pause banner quad via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad

name: ovl23_load_ui_vram_and_sprites
summary: Reads A_FILE partition 0 offset 0x25000, unpacks 0x0d VRAM pack, copies sprite table, and inits 0x0e anim g_ovl23_vram_sprites_value_2

name: ovl23_load_common_vram_pack
summary: Syncs GPU via DrawSync/ClearOTagR, reads A_FILE partition 0 (0x2000 bytes), and unpacks common 0x0d VRAM textures

name: ovl23_load_racer_sprites_and_vram

name: ovl23_setup_race_bgm

name: ovl23_add_girl_affection

name: hm_ovl25_tomato_fest_entry

name: hm_ovl25_tomato_fest_init

name: ovl25_phase_pre_match_fade_in

name: ovl25_update_scene_and_dispatch_mode
summary: Steps GTE camera, lighting, 3D stage model, VRAM tile anims, sub-mode table g_ovl25_scene_dispatch_mode_fn_ptr[g_ovl25_trail_buffers_push_scene_state], and sky tint cycle each frame.

summary: Initializes 6 participant structs at g_ovl25_trail_buffers_push_scene_state (state=1, stamina=0x32000, positions from g_ovl25_actors_match_value_1), 2 NPCs from g_ovl25_actors_match_value_2, and sets g_ovl25_actors_match_tutorial_count_1/019e.

name: ovl25_reset_actors_for_tutorial
summary: Resets 6 participant structs at g_ovl25_trail_buffers_push_scene_state (state=0, stamina=0x32000, positions from g_ovl25_actors_tutorial_value_1), 2 NPCs from g_ovl25_actors_tutorial_value_2, and sets g_ovl25_actors_match_tutorial_count_1/019e.

name: ovl25_mode_tutorial_sequence
summary: Renders festival world and steps tutorial state table g_ovl25_mode_tutorial_sequence_fn_ptr[g_ovl25_minigame_config_mode_tutorial_counter], transitioning g_ovl25_trail_buffers_push_scene_state to 1 after step 6.

name: hm_ovl25_tomato_fest_loop

name: ovl25_handle_player_input_and_prompts

name: ovl25_update_ai_actors
summary: Updates AI team behaviors across g_ovl25_ai_actors_value_1..0x800c00ac using stamina thresholds, ovl25_ai_roll_action_chance, and ovl25_ai_choose_throw_action.

name: ovl25_update_camera_follow_x
summary: Smoothly pans camera target g_core_spawn_pos_x toward player X g_ovl25_mode_countdown_start_player_camera_cfg_input_prompts (clamped at 0xce4), zeroes g_core_spawn_pos_y, and sets g_core_spawn_pos_z to g_ovl25_mode_countdown_start_player_camera_cfg_1.

name: ovl25_step_all_actors
summary: Decrements action cooldown timers for all 6 festival participants at g_ovl25_player_input_prompts_all_match_count and invokes ovl25_step_actor_state_machine on each.

name: ovl25_step_actor_state_machine
summary: Updates participant state machine via jump tables 0x800b7e3c/0x800b7e54, clamps fixed-point stamina [0..0x31fff], and adjusts SFX voice volume.

summary: Evaluates finish-line crossings (g_ovl25_minigame_config_match_tutorial_counter-0x140) across all 6 actors, records winner in g_ovl25_match_finish_rewards_value_1/74, awards NPC points on player win, and advances phase.

name: ovl25_render_festival_world
summary: Renders all festival actors, player stamina gauge, goal markers, and flying tomato/crowd props in composite frame draw pass.

name: ovl25_draw_all_actors
summary: Submits sprites for all 6 festival participants at g_ovl25_player_input_prompts_all_match_count and 2 NPCs at g_ovl25_mode_countdown_start_all_count via ovl25_draw_participant_sprite and ovl25_draw_npc_sprite.

name: ovl25_ai_update_recovery_or_throw
summary: Evaluates AI dodge/hide transition for actor_ptr via ovl25_ai_roll_action_chance(..., 4) or delegates throw timing to ovl25_ai_choose_throw_action.

name: ovl25_ai_choose_throw_action
summary: Selects AI throw timing using hm_prng_next(100) and weight table 0x800bccc0 by stamina tier, then transitions actor_ptr to state 5.

name: ovl25_can_actor_accept_input
summary: Returns 1 if participant state at actor_ptr+2 is neither 4 nor 7, allowing player input, or 0 otherwise.

name: ovl25_ai_roll_action_chance
summary: Rolls hm_prng_next(0x80) against threshold table g_ovl25_ai_roll_action_chance_table for actor role and action_idx, returning true when threshold is met.

name: ovl25_advance_actor_movement
summary: Advances participant X position and drains stamina via ovl25_get_move_speed_for_stamina and ovl25_get_stamina_drain_rate, resetting expired states to 2.

name: ovl25_get_move_speed_for_stamina
summary: Maps 12-bit fixed-point stamina meter_fp (>>12) to horizontal movement speed tier (0x46, 100, 0x82, or 0xa0).

name: ovl25_get_stamina_drain_rate
summary: Returns fixed-point stamina drain rate (-2 if (meter_fp>>12) >= 10, else 0) used when advancing participant meter.

name: ovl25_set_actor_state
summary: Transitions participant actor_ptr+2 to new_state and sets timer at actor_ptr+4 to duration when state changes.

name: ovl25_draw_participant_sprite
summary: Selects body and shadow sprite animations from role/state of actor_ptr, updates via hm_sprite_set_anim_state, and projects via hm_ovl25_tomato_fest_throw and ovl25_project_sprite_to_ot.

name: ovl25_draw_npc_sprite
summary: Updates spectator/referee animation state (9..0xc) on npc_actor+0x18, decrements timer at +4, and projects sprite via hm_ovl25_tomato_fest_throw.

name: ovl25_draw_goal_marker_sprites

name: ovl25_update_props_and_tomato_arc
summary: Updates festival props g_ovl25_props_tomato_arc_pause_resume_value_1..0x800c0424, crowd runner animations, and parabolic tomato flight g_ovl25_mode_countdown_start_player_props_flag..54 with impact SFX 0x4d.

name: ovl25_pause_all_sprites
summary: Pauses animation playback via hm_res_spr_anim_step_a(..., 4) across all festival participant, NPC, prop, and HUD HmSpriteActor instances.

name: ovl25_resume_all_sprites
summary: Resumes animation playback via hm_res_spr_anim_step_b(..., 4) across all festival participant, NPC, prop, and HUD HmSpriteActor instances.

name: ovl25_draw_pause_overlay_sprite
summary: Sets pause banner sprite g_ovl25_pause_all_sprites_resume_overlay_value to frame 0 and submits centered HUD quad using g_ui_hud_money_state/g_ui_tick_rucksack_pause_menu_betting_cfg via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad.

name: hm_ovl25_tomato_fest_throw
summary: Spawns thrown tomato arc from actor_ptr toward aim_pos and checks cover hit

name: ovl25_project_sprite_to_ot

name: ovl25_tutorial_step_confirm_prompt

summary: Shows tutorial closing dialogue 0x34, starts screen fade-out via hm_res_cd_wait_load_sync(10,0,2), and advances g_ovl25_minigame_config_mode_tutorial_counter to 5.

name: ovl25_init_camera_rig
summary: Initializes festival camera distance/elevation parameters in g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars..94 and spawn target g_core_spawn_pos_x..a8.

name: ovl25_update_camera_offset_gte
summary: Computes rotated 3D camera offset g_gfx_cam_offset_x..a0 via GTE RotMatrix and RotTrans from g_gfx_camera_offset_gte_render_compute_state_livestock_models..24 and yaw g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx3.

name: ovl25_load_tomato_sprite_pack

name: ovl25_clear_vram_anim_slots
summary: Zeroes the 8 VRAM tile animation slots at g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 (0xb4 bytes) via memset and marks each slot ID as 0xffff.

name: ovl25_register_map_vram_anims
summary: Iterates 8 tile animation descriptors at map_desc+0x8a8 and registers each non-(-1) entry via ovl25_register_vram_anim_slot.

name: ovl25_update_vram_anim_slots
summary: Steps all active VRAM tile animation slots at g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 via ovl25_step_vram_frame_anim or ovl25_step_vram_scroll_anim when unpaused.

name: ovl25_step_vram_scroll_anim

name: ovl25_register_vram_anim_slot
summary: Registers unique tile animation descriptor anim_desc into first free slot (-1) of g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 (8 slots, stride 0x16 bytes).

name: ovl25_add_npc_friendship_points

name: ovl25_add_npc_affection_points

name: ovl25_set_clear_bg_color

name: ovl25_update_sky_color_cycle

name: hm_ovl27_title_intro_loop

name: hm_ovl27_title_draw_menu

name: ovl27_wait_fade_and_stop_audio

name: ovl27_exit_to_next_overlay
summary: Finalizes New Game, Continue, or attract demo exit flags in g_core_engine_flags0/g_core_scene_flags and transitions to overlay 2 or 8 via hm_res_sys_wait_vblank.

summary: Starts title logo intro sequence, steps background scene via hm_ovl27_title_step_demo_scene, resets g_ovl27_overlay_state_logo_title_state, and sets state to ovl27_intro_anim_wait.

name: ovl27_intro_anim_wait

name: ovl27_intro_anim_slide_logo
summary: Slides main title logo into position by incrementing g_ovl27_logo_vars_intro_counter_slide to 0, then transitions g_ovl27_title_menu_intro_wait_fn_ptr to ovl27_intro_anim_slide_subtitle.

name: ovl27_intro_anim_slide_subtitle

name: ovl27_intro_anim_slide_press_start

name: ovl27_intro_anim_exit_press_start

name: pad_calc_analog_angle
