name: hm_memcard_set_target_slot
summary: Selects active Memory Card port, slot, and save diary index for subsequent I/O

name: hm_cd_read_named_file
summary: Resolves ISO9660 path via CdSearchFile and streams file sectors synchronously into dst_buf

name: hm_afile_load_entry_sync
summary: Looks up index in A_FILE.BIN TOC table, issues CdRead sectors, and blocks until completion

name: hm_cd_init_afile_system
summary: Initializes CD subsystem callbacks and reads master A_FILE.BIN index table into RAM

name: hm_cd_poll_async_queue
summary: Advances pending CD async read queue and invokes completion handlers on CdSync done

name: hm_cd_get_afile_lba_size
summary: Computes sector LBA and byte length for an A_FILE.BIN archive entry

name: hm_cd_enqueue_async_read
summary: Enqueues an asynchronous A_FILE.BIN CD sector transfer into the resident CD job ring

name: hm_cd_is_queue_busy
summary: Returns non-zero while resident CD async read queue has active or pending transfers

name: hm_vram_queue_rect_upload
summary: Schedules LoadImage DMA transfer of pixel rectangle and optional CLUT into PS1 VRAM

name: hm_afile_read_or_load_overlay
summary: Loads an A_FILE.BIN archive entry or executable overlay part directly into target RAM

name: gfx_alloc_tile1_prim
summary: Allocates 0xc bytes from frame primitive pool hm_clamp_fade_level and emits a 1x1 TILE_1 primitive into ot_entry.

name: gfx_alloc_line_f2_prim
summary: Allocates 0x10 bytes from hm_clamp_fade_level and emits a LINE_F2 primitive into ot_entry.

name: gfx_alloc_poly_g4_rect
summary: Allocates primitive storage via hm_clamp_fade_level and emits a 4-color Gouraud POLY_G4 rectangle into ot_entry.

name: gfx_alloc_poly_f4_rect
summary: Allocates 0x18 bytes from hm_clamp_fade_level and emits a flat POLY_F4 rectangle into ot_entry.

name: hm_draw_poly_f4_panel
summary: Appends a semi-transparent or opaque flat POLY_F4 quad primitive to the ordering table

name: gfx_alloc_poly_f4_with_tpage
summary: Allocates primitive buffer, builds POLY_F4 + DR_TPAGE via gfx_emit_poly_f4_with_tpage, and advances pool via hm_step_screen_fade.

name: gfx_emit_tile1_prim
summary: Builds a 1x1 TILE_1 primitive (code 0x68/0x6a) at (x,y), links it into ot_entry, and returns the next buffer pointer.

name: gfx_emit_line_f2_prim
summary: Builds a flat LINE_F2 primitive (code 0x40/0x42) between (x0,y0) and (x1,y1), links into ot_entry, and advances prim_buf.

name: gfx_emit_poly_g4_rect
summary: Builds a 4-corner Gouraud POLY_G4 rectangle (code 0x38/0x3a) with per-vertex colors, links into ot_entry, and returns next prim pointer.

name: gfx_emit_poly_f4_rect
summary: Builds a flat-shaded POLY_F4 rectangle (code 0x28/0x2a) at (x,y,w,h), links into ot_entry, and advances prim_buf.

name: gfx_emit_tile_rect_prim
summary: Builds a colored TILE primitive (code 0x60/0x62) of size (w,h) at (x,y), links into ot_entry, and advances prim_buf.

name: gfx_emit_poly_f4_with_tpage
summary: Calls gfx_emit_poly_f4_rect and prepends a DR_TPAGE/ABR blend mode packet onto ot_entry.

name: hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim
summary: Initializes 0x0E sprite animation pack descriptor and reports ANI INIT ERROR on invalid magic

name: hm_sprite_set_anim_state
summary: Assigns active animation sequence index on a 0x0E sprite descriptor slot

name: gfx_sprite_set_header_and_ctx
summary: Assigns compressed sprite header pointer spr_hdr and user context word user_ctx on HmSpriteActor.

name: hm_sprite_step_0x0e_frame
summary: Advances frame timer and loops or clamps keyframe cursor for a 0x0E sprite descriptor

name: gfx_sprite_lookup_cel_id
summary: Indexes sprite sheet tables at +0x28 and +0x2c by anim_id and frame_idx (stride 10) to resolve the 16-bit cel/frame ID.

name: gfx_sprite_lookup_part_idx
summary: Searches table_hdr entries at sprite_sheet+0x1c via bcmp to resolve matching sprite part/bank index.

name: hm_sprite_play_at_pos
summary: Steps and draws a 0x0E sprite animation slot at screen coordinates (x, y)

name: gfx_sprite_draw_actor_at
summary: Draws sprite actor active animation/cel at (x,y) via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad and advances animation timer via hm_sprite_step_0x0e_frame.

name: gfx_sprite_draw_actor_simple
summary: Draws sprite actor current cel (+4) at (x,y) via gfx_sprite_draw_layer_wrapper and ticks actor animation via hm_sprite_step_0x0e_frame.

name: hm_sprite_flush_active_lists
summary: Flushes queued active sprite slots into GPU ordering tables prior to OT swap

name: gfx_sprite_draw_actor_tinted
summary: Draws scaled/tinted sprite actor frame via hm_sprite_submit_scaled_rot and updates actor animation state via hm_sprite_step_0x0e_frame.

name: gfx_sprite_emit_active_char
summary: Reads active frame OT from g_gfx_active_disp_ctx_ptr+0x118 and emits character sprite frame via gfx_sprite_emit_char_frame.

name: gfx_sprite_draw_frame_wrapper
summary: Register-forwarding wrapper invoking core sprite frame submission routine hm_sprite_build_sprt_packet.

name: gfx_sprite_draw_layer_wrapper
summary: Register-forwarding wrapper invoking layered sprite draw routine hm_sprite_build_poly_ft4_packet.

name: hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad
summary: Builds and links a 0x0E sprite frame primitive at (x, y) into the ordering table

name: hm_sprite_submit_scaled_rot
summary: Applies screen fade scaling then submits a transformed 0x0E sprite quad

name: gfx_sprite_draw_save_retaddr
summary: Captures caller return address into g_ovl15_diary_serialize_save_payload_deserialize_state_sprite_retaddr and forwards to layered sprite draw routine hm_sprite_build_poly_ft4_packet.

name: gfx_sprite_submit_scaled_rot
summary: Allocates GPU packet memory, submits transformed/colored sprite quad via hm_sprite_build_poly_ft4_packet, and commits pool pointer via hm_step_screen_fade.

name: gfx_sprite_submit_basic
summary: Submits uncolored sprite cel via hm_sprite_build_poly_ft4_packet with default RGB (-1) and advances primitive pool via hm_step_screen_fade.

name: hm_sprite_build_sprt_packet
summary: Emits an unscaled PS1 SPRT GPU packet from parsed 0x0E frame dimensions and UV coordinates

name: hm_sprite_build_poly_ft4_packet
summary: Emits a scaled/rotated textured POLY_FT4 packet into the active OT and returns next packet cursor

name: gfx_sprite_draw_part_offset
summary: Resolves sprite part index via gfx_sprite_lookup_part_idx and emits its primitive via hm_vram_upload_tim_chunk.

name: gfx_sprite_emit_char_frame
summary: Emits full character/entity sprite primitive using gfx_sprite_draw_part_offset, applying active display scale/flip/tint.

name: hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_pack_auto
summary: Inspects 0x0D pack header and dispatches LZ/RLE VRAM decompression to embedded coords

name: gfx_sprite_reset_actor_slot
summary: Calls sprite actor command hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_lz_rle with op=1 and zero bounds to reset/release actor slot.

name: gfx_sprite_spawn_actor_slot
summary: Calls hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_lz_rle with op=0 to initialize a world/screen sprite actor at (x,y,z).

name: gfx_sprite_update_actor_slot
summary: Calls hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_lz_rle with op=2 to update sprite actor coordinates and flags.

name: gfx_sprite_draw_frame_direct
summary: Resolves cel ID and part index via gfx_sprite_lookup_cel_id/part_idx and draws into active frame via hm_vram_upload_tim_chunk.

name: hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_lz_rle
summary: Decompresses 0x0D LZ/RLE texture/CLUT payload into texture staging buffer and calls LoadImage

name: hm_vram_upload_tim_chunk
summary: Parses TIM/pixel rectangle header and uploads image/CLUT data to PS1 VRAM via LoadImage

name: hud_res_clear_text_ptr_wrap
summary: Tail-calls hud_res_clear_text_ptr (hud_res_clear_text_ptr) to clear active dialogue token pointer.

name: hm_text_set_margins
summary: Sets global text wrapping margin X/Y bounds

name: hud_res_set_text_color_idx
summary: Clamps text color palette index to <= 6 and stores it into g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_box_flags.

name: hud_res_get_text_color_idx
summary: Returns active text color palette index from g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_box_flags.

name: hud_res_set_text_speed
summary: Clamps speed preset index (< 3, else 1) and loads character delay from g_ui_hud_text_speed_table into g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x02_idx3.

name: hud_res_get_text_speed_idx
summary: Maps current character delay g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x02_idx3 (0, 5, or other) back to text speed index 0, 2, or 1.

name: hud_res_arm_text_step
summary: Transitions dialogue typewriter pause state g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x02 from 0 (idle) to 1 (armed).

name: hud_res_advance_text_step
summary: When g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x02 is 1 or 3, resets it to 0 and advances page/line counter g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx.

name: hm_text_set_render_mode
summary: Sets active dialogue/font glyph rendering mode word

name: hud_res_get_active_speaker_id
summary: Returns current speaker/portrait actor ID stored in g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_col_x.

name: hm_text_draw_dialog_line
summary: Fades and draws a positioned dialogue line via hm_text_render_glyph_stream

name: hud_res_render_dialogue_box_wrap
summary: Thin wrapper sign-extending bounds arguments into hud_res_render_dialogue_box (hud_res_render_dialogue_box).

name: hud_res_get_dialog_line_y_wrap
summary: Tail-calls hud_res_get_dialog_line_y (hud_res_get_dialog_line_y) to compute line Y offset.

name: hud_res_get_loaded_portrait_id
summary: Returns currently cached portrait slot ID from g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_held_item_state.

name: hud_res_set_loaded_portrait_id
summary: Updates both g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_held_item_state and g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x1c with the active dialogue portrait ID.

name: hud_res_draw_box_text_centered
summary: Renders centered dialogue/HUD text within box_w using current spacing g_ui_text_margins_hud_box_counter_1 via hud_res_draw_tok_centered_clipped.

name: hud_res_draw_box_text_right
summary: Renders right-aligned dialogue/HUD text within box_w using current spacing g_ui_text_margins_hud_box_counter_1 via hud_res_draw_tok_right_clipped.

name: hud_res_draw_wrapped_text
summary: Allocates scratch buffer via hm_clamp_fade_level and draws multiline dialogue text via hm_text_render_glyph_stream and hm_step_screen_fade.

name: hud_res_concat_tok_str
summary: Appends a 0xFFFF-terminated 16-bit glyph token string from src onto the end of dst and returns dst.

name: hud_res_step_dialog_tokens
summary: Parses and advances active dialogue control tokens (pauses, portraits, choices, choices paging, and newline scroll).

name: hud_res_render_dialogue_box
summary: Core dialogue renderer emitting DR_AREA scissor packets, advancing typewriter delay, and drawing visible glyphs/choices.

name: hud_res_clear_text_ptr
summary: Clears active dialogue script pointer g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_text_base to null.

name: hm_text_render_glyph_stream
summary: Decodes control codes, Kanji/ASCII glyph indices, and submits character sprites to OT

name: hud_res_get_dialog_line_y
summary: Computes dialogue window text Y coordinate using g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x34_off_2, minus (12 + g_ui_text_margins_hud_box_counter_1) if previous token was newline -2.

name: gfx_emit_font_glyph_sprt
summary: Emits a 12x12 font SPRT + DR_TPAGE packet using glyph UV lookup and CLUT table g_ui_emit_font_glyph_sprt_value, linking into ot_entry.

name: hud_res_wrap_text_to_width
summary: Wraps glyph token stream to line/width bounds using hud_res_count_line_glyphs, returning pointer past fit slice.

name: hud_res_measure_line_tokens
summary: Counts glyphs and measures pixel line width up to stop_tok or max_glyphs, expanding embedded macros via hm_font_lookup_kanji_glyph.

name: hud_res_measure_wrapped_height
summary: Computes total line count/span for wrapped token string by pairing hud_res_wrap_text_to_width and hud_res_count_line_glyphs.

name: hud_res_count_line_glyphs
summary: Walks a glyph token string up to stop_tok or 0xFFFF, recursively counting expanded macro tokens via hm_font_lookup_kanji_glyph.

name: hud_res_draw_text_default
summary: Renders a glyph token string at (x,y) with default 0x1000 scale and palette via hm_text_render_glyph_stream.

name: hud_res_get_text_step_state
summary: Returns current dialogue wait/step state g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x02.

name: hud_res_reset_text_step
summary: Resets dialogue page counter g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx and step state g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x02 to 0.

name: hud_res_draw_tok_centered_clipped
summary: Copies tokenized text to stack line buffer and renders centered lines within box_w via hud_res_draw_text_centered.

name: hud_res_draw_text_centered
summary: Measures string width with hud_res_measure_tok_str_width and draws horizontally centered text within box_w.

name: hud_res_measure_tok_str_width
summary: Recursively measures pixel width of a 16-bit glyph token string including 0x4000 macro expansions in g_ui_text_render_glyph_stream_hud_table.

name: hud_res_draw_text_right_aligned
summary: Measures string width with hud_res_measure_tok_str_width and draws right-aligned text anchored to x + box_w.

name: hud_res_draw_tok_right_clipped
summary: Copies tokenized text to stack line buffer and renders right-aligned lines within box_w via hud_res_draw_text_right_aligned.

name: hud_res_tick_choice_menu_input
summary: Handles up/down/confirm D-pad input on an interactive dialogue choice list and draws the aligned cursor.

name: hud_res_draw_cursor_aligned
summary: Renders choice menu cursor sprite offset by (+8, +6) via evt_res_draw_cursor_hand.

name: hud_res_map_choice_result
summary: Maps 1-based choice index (1..4, else 0) through lookup table g_ui_hud_map_choice_result_value.

name: hud_res_draw_cursor_indicator
summary: Allocates 0x14 + 8 bytes from hm_clamp_fade_level and links a text cursor sprite/glyph packet when glyph_id != -1.

name: hud_res_decode_portrait_idx
summary: Converts portrait control token (0x0fef - (token & 0xffff)) into signed portrait resource index.

name: hud_res_free_portrait_slot
summary: Releases active portrait VRAM/sprite allocation via hm_vram_unpack_0x0d_pack_auto and evt_res_clear_portrait_busy when slot changes.

name: hud_res_load_portrait_slot
summary: Acquires portrait DMA buffer via evt_res_get_portrait_buf_if_idle and loads portrait AFILE entry via hm_afile_read_or_load_overlay.

name: hud_res_advance_dialog_choice_page
summary: Advances active dialogue token cursor g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_text_cursor past choice marker 0x0ffb and resets step state.

name: hud_res_collect_dialog_choice_lines
summary: Scans choice line markers in g_ui_hud_collect_dialog_choice_value_1/g_ui_hud_collect_dialog_choice_value_2 against g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_text_cursor to populate interactive choice prompts.

name: hm_font_lookup_kanji_glyph
summary: Maps Shift-JIS/custom font character code into resident glyph tile bitmap table

name: hud_res_expand_script_macro
summary: Invokes text macro handler g_ui_hud_expand_script_macro_fn_ptr[macro_id % 3](macro_id / 3) and advances g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_text_cursor until 0xFFFF.

name: hud_res_append_unflagged_item
summary: Appends name tokens into g_ui_font_lookup_kanji_glyph_hud_value from item/recipe array g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (0x14 entries) where flag 0x10000 is clear.

name: hud_res_append_flagged_item
summary: Appends name tokens into g_ui_font_lookup_kanji_glyph_hud_value from item/recipe array g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (0x14 entries) where flag 0x10000 is set.

name: hud_res_append_tool_name
summary: Appends name tokens into g_ui_font_lookup_kanji_glyph_hud_value from 10-entry tool/crop table g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl via hud_res_append_record_name.

name: hud_res_append_record_name
summary: Checks visibility bits 0x100/0x80000 at record+0x34 and appends record name tokens via hud_res_concat_tok_str.

name: hud_res_resolve_macro_name
summary: Calls hm_text_fetch_script_entry(macro_id, tokens, entry_idx - 1) and skips 0x0ffd terminator padding if present.

name: hud_res_ascii_to_glyph_tok
summary: Translates an ASCII byte to an internal 16-bit font glyph token via character class table g_ui_hud_ascii_glyph_tok_flag and punctuation switch.

name: hm_text_fetch_script_entry
summary: Resolves message ID in loaded dialogue bank offset table and returns text pointer and byte length

name: hud_res_copy_6tok_preset
summary: Copies 6 halfword glyph tokens from table g_ui_hud_copy_6tok_preset_table (stride 0xc) into dst.

name: hud_res_draw_preset_label
summary: Expands preset text string into g_ui_hud_preset_label_cfg via hm_text_fetch_script_entry and draws it via hm_text_draw_dialog_line.

name: hm_text_draw_box_with_message
summary: Draws framed UI box and renders resolved dialogue script entry at (x, y)

name: hud_res_reset_portrait_cache
summary: Resets active dialogue portrait globals g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_choice_index, g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_pad_0x1c to 0xFFFF and g_ui_dialogue_box_ctx_held_item_state to 0xFFFD.

name: hud_res_open_portrait_by_token
summary: Resets portrait cache, decodes token via hud_res_decode_portrait_idx, and loads/frees portrait slot.

name: hud_res_draw_choice_cursor_offset
summary: Decodes cursor glyph token via hud_res_decode_portrait_idx and draws indicator offset by (-4, -0x54).

name: hud_res_switch_portrait_by_token
summary: Checks if decoded portrait ID differs from hud_res_get_loaded_portrait_id and switches portrait slots when changed.

name: hud_res_draw_choice_cursor_abs
summary: Decodes glyph token via hud_res_decode_portrait_idx and renders indicator at exact (x, y) via hud_res_draw_cursor_indicator.

name: hud_res_find_active_flag_bit
summary: Scans festival/flag bitfields g_core_player_state_mount_and_interact_vars_idx2 and g_core_player_state_action_sub_vars_idx10 using sys_int_pow(2, g_player_equipped_tool + 1) to select active entry.

name: hm_event_flag_get
summary: Tests bit index bit_idx inside global persistent game progress bitfield g_hm_event_flags_bitset

name: hm_event_flag_set
summary: Sets or clears bit index bit_idx inside persistent game progress bitfield g_hm_event_flags_bitset

name: gfx_reset_ot_sprite_table
summary: Clears 0x1300 bytes at g_gfx_ot_sprite_table_gpu_swap_clearotagr_arg and resets screen color/tint state via hm_gpu_reset_ot_and_sprites.

name: gfx_set_screen_tint_rgb
summary: Forwards six RGB tint/gradient parameters directly to screen overlay configuration helper hm_gpu_reset_ot_and_sprites.

name: hm_gpu_reset_ot_and_sprites
summary: Clears double-buffered reverse ordering tables via ClearOTagR and resets sprite scratch pointers

name: gfx_clear_overlay_busy_flag
summary: Clears screen transition/filter busy flag g_gfx_gpu_ot_sprites_clear_overlay_state to 0.

name: gfx_get_overlay_busy_flag
summary: Returns screen transition/filter busy flag g_gfx_gpu_ot_sprites_clear_overlay_state.

name: hm_gpu_swap_buffers_and_draw_ot
summary: Flushes sprite lists, waits DrawSync/VSync, swaps active DISPENV/DRAWENV, and calls DrawOTag

name: gfx_tick_screen_filter_slots
summary: Iterates screen fade/filter slots in g_gfx_tick_screen_filter_slots_start_value and invokes active handlers via table g_rodata_spu_dispatch_tbl.

name: gfx_start_screen_filter
summary: Starts screen fade/wipe slot g_gfx_tick_screen_filter_slots_start_value[slot] with effect_type when g_core_engine_flags0 bit 0x10000 is clear and pad IO is ready.

name: gfx_reset_primary_filter_slot
summary: Wrapper calling gfx_reset_filter_slot (gfx_reset_filter_slot) on default filter slot.

name: gfx_tick_fade_wipe_slot
summary: Advances brightness wipe timer in g_gfx_tick_fade_wipe_slot_filter_table/g_gfx_start_screen_filter_tick_slot_table[slot] and resets slot upon reaching target byte.

name: gfx_set_filter_slot_noop
summary: Empty stub for screen filter slot parameter assignment.

name: gfx_reset_filter_slot
summary: Clears filter slot entry g_gfx_tick_screen_filter_slots_start_value[slot] and resets auxiliary color flags g_gfx_tick_fade_wipe_slot_filter_flag_1/g_gfx_tick_fade_wipe_slot_filter_flag_2.

name: gfx_init_3d_scene_defaults
summary: Configures default 320x240 geom offset (160,120), H=1000, eye (0,0,0x1000), target (0,0,-0x1000), and zeroed scene state.

name: hm_gte_init_light_fog_matrices
summary: Loads GTE light, color, far-color, and fog-near matrices for 3D scene rendering

name: gfx_gte_rebuild_iso_view_matrix
summary: Recomputes GTE view/projection matrix from eye g_gfx_camera_iso_state and target g_gfx_camera_iso_state_target using CrossProduct0/VectorNormal/ScaleMatrix.

name: gfx_cam_set_eye
summary: Stores camera eye coordinates into g_gfx_camera_iso_state..df0 and roll into g_gfx_camera_iso_state_roll, marking view matrix dirty (g_gfx_camera_iso_state_custom_view_flag=0).

name: gfx_cam_set_target
summary: Stores camera look-at target into g_gfx_camera_iso_state_target..dfc and marks GTE view matrix dirty (g_gfx_camera_iso_state_custom_view_flag=0).

name: gfx_light_set_vec_and_rgb
summary: Normalizes dir with VectorNormalSS and configures light direction and RGB color matrices for slot light_idx.

name: gfx_light_set_rot_and_rgb
summary: Builds light rotation matrix via RotMatrix_gte/ApplyMatrix and updates GTE light and color matrices for light_idx.

name: hm_gte_draw_static_model
summary: Pushes GTE matrix stack, transforms static 3D model primitives, and emits packets to OT

name: hm_gte_draw_animated_model
summary: Evaluates hierarchical bone transforms for animated 3D character/animal mesh and submits polygons

name: gfx_frustum_cull_point_planes
summary: Tests world point offset from camera eye g_gfx_frustum_cull_point_planes_build_state_1 against six view frustum planes using GTE vector/matrix products.

name: hm_gte_emit_model_polys
summary: Inner GTE loop calling gte_ldv0/gte_stsxy3_g3/gte_stopz to cull and emit textured/Gouraud tris & quads

name: gfx_tri_in_screen_bounds
summary: Checks packed screen-space vertex coords against 320x240 viewport margins [-0x13..0x153].

name: gfx_quad_in_screen_bounds
summary: Checks four horizontal screen coordinates against viewport bounds [-0x13..0x153], returning true if any vertex is inside.

name: gfx_build_frustum_planes
summary: Builds 6 camera frustum clipping planes at g_gfx_frustum_cull_point_planes_build_count from eye and target vectors using GTE RotMatrix and CrossProduct12.

name: gfx_gte_refresh_rot_matrix
summary: Reads current GTE rotation matrix via gte_ReadRotMatrix and normalizes/updates matrix state.

name: gfx_init_poly_ft4_uv_tpage_clut
summary: Writes quad UV coordinates onto a POLY_FT4 and populates tpage and clut fields via getTPage/getClut helpers.

name: gfx_prim_cull_stub_zero
summary: Returns 0 unconditionally as a disabled 3D primitive culling/clipping stub.

name: gfx_emit_gte_ot_poly_b
summary: Transforms vertices with GTE, checks culling/bounds, and links primitive into ordering table via gfx_clamp_ot_index_stub.

name: gfx_emit_gte_ot_poly_a
summary: Transforms quad/tri vertices through GTE, tests bounds via gfx_prim_cull_stub_zero, and submits packet into active OT via gfx_clamp_ot_index_stub.

name: hm_gte_project_svector_to_ot
summary: Transforms single SVECTOR via GTE perspective projection and returns depth OTZ + screen XY

name: gfx_gte_project_vec3_16
summary: Packs 3-axis coords from pos32[0,2,4] into a local SVECTOR and projects via hm_gte_project_svector_to_ot.

name: gfx_gte_rtps_get_otz
summary: Transforms one SVECTOR through GTE gte_ldv0/gte_rtps and returns the resulting ordering table Z value.

name: gfx_clamp_ot_index_stub
summary: Clamps ot_idx against g_gfx_active_disp_ctx_ptr+0x110 and indexes active OT slot at g_gfx_active_disp_ctx_ptr+0x120.

name: gfx_ot_submit_noop
summary: Empty stub following ordering table boundary selection.
